This is a new role, reporting directly to the CMO, that gives Babylist's brand an architecture for the future as we continue to expand the role we play in our customer’s lives. This role will lead positioning, visual identity, and creative output, and builds the system that lets marketers, designers and others ship on\-brand without waiting on a gatekeeper. You'll lead the creative studio, campaign concepting, video center of excellence and run Partnership Marketing to support our sales team and the commercial side of brand partnerships. This is a builder's job: Babylist sits at 15% aided brand awareness with over 75 NPS. We are loved by many but have real headroom to close the awareness gap, and that's the mandate. To do this, we will be investing more in demand generation content with paid media to reach the right audiences. This role will shape the creative direction, messaging, outcomes and learning for this work. The work will be structured around Marketing’s role in driving new customer acquisition and unlocking more value from the customers we already have.


**Who You Are**


* **You've built and scaled a brand system, not just a brand look.** You know the difference between a style guide that sits in a drive and one people actually are able to use. You have excellent taste and appreciate the role that the brand system plays in winning with our customers and differentiating our brand in the marketplace.
* **You think in campaigns, not just assets.** You understand who we want to win with and can deliver the big idea that anchors a major brand moment and carry it across channels without losing the thread. You think in terms of tentpole moments and have experience in defining a cultural calendar that puts brands into culture.
* **You lead creative production directly** including photography, brand film, high\-production video and know how to get expensive\-feeling work out of a lean team. You will invest in building partnerships with external partners that become trusted collaborators in how we build content that tells our story.
* **You build systems, not gates.** You'd rather turn the brand book into something AI\-enabled and self\-serve than personally approve every asset that ships, and you know how to build the guardrails that make that safe. We need to increase capacity and ship at pace while protecting our very trusted human voice and expertise. This will require someone who is a partner across marketing, product designand the company. You have a track record of collaborating with other teams, bringing curiosity to conversations with product and marketing teams and take a consultative approach. This includes building systems that will consider how photos, video, still and dynamic content will flow into a product design system and customer experience to deliver a cohesive brand experience.
* **You build systems, not gates**. You'd rather turn the brand book into something AI\-enabled and self\-service than personally approve every asset that ships, and you know how to build the guardrails that make that safe. You champion codifying the brand visual system \- illustration, photography, motion, etc \- into the product design system, so consistency holds across the full funnel and brand and product sharpen each other instead of drifting apart.You build the mechanisms needed to increase capacity and ship at pace while protecting our very trusted human voice and expertise end\-to\-end across our customer’s journey. You have a track record of collaborating with other teams, bringing curiosity to conversations with partners in and outside of marketing and taking a consultative approach.
* **You've run a partner or co\-marketing program** including retail activations, brand partnerships, sponsored content and know how to protect brand integrity while making commercial partners feel the work is genuinely good. You can support reporting results and bring the gravitas to executive meetings with partners that will inspire deeper partnerships.
* You naturally reach for AI in your work. At Babylist, every team uses AI daily. You're already using it to move faster and improve your output, and you stay curious about what's coming next.


**How You Will Make An Impact**


* Own Babylist's brand positioning, visual identity system, and long\-term brand architecture — the point of view every other function borrows from.
* Lead the creative studio: design across brand, campaign, digital, and photography direction; brand film and high\-production video.
* Partner with the Product Design team who is key partner and drives how the visual design system is utilized across our most important customer surfaces including the app and our .com experience.
* Own campaign concepting for Babylist's biggest brand moments, from idea to execution across every channel. Partner with your peer and their team on the Content Team that will create and execute owned social, editorial, influencer and community as well as with the head of Corporate Communications \& Experiential (which oversees our showrooms in NY \& LA)
* Define the handshake between creative studio and content teams alongside the Sr. Director, Content, Social \& Creator Marketing and do not just follow one that's handed to you.
* Partner with engineering to turn the brand book into a living , AI\-accessible system or a brand brain that lets marketers and product designers across the company check their own work against the standard and ship without a manual approval queue. And ensure there is an approach to maintaining the brain and feeding it learnings.
* Lead Partnership Marketing: brand partner co\-marketing, retail activations, and branded content sponsorships, with a director reporting directly to you.


**Why This Role**


* You're building the function from a strong brand foundation but at a moment when our ambitions are bigger and demand generation will have real investment. Brand strategy at Babylist is something that will have a bigger remit in our evolution and this is an opportunity to set the scope up with ambition and create something that fuels our next chapter of growth.
* You report directly to the CMO, with a direct hand in how millions of families experience Babylist at one of the most emotional moments of their lives.
* Babylist has real brand love and real headroom with 15% aided awareness with a business that already works. You're not finding a market; you're building the story for one Babylist already owns.
* You'll own the shift from manual brand gatekeeping to an AI\-enabled system that scales a genuinely new kind of brand leadership, not a retread of the old creative director job.


**About Compensation**



We use a market\-based approach to compensation. The starting salary range for this role is:


**$212,712 to $283,694 \+ target 25% annual bonus and competitive equity**



Your starting salary will be based on your location, experience, and qualifications, with increases over time tied to performance, role growth, and internal pay equity.


**Who We Are**



Babylist is the leading platform for expecting and new families. More than 10 million people shop with Babylist every year, making it the go\-to destination for seamless purchasing, guidance, and expert recommendations. As a modern, AI\-forward tech company, Babylist has expanded from a universal registry into a full ecosystem — the Babylist Shop, Babylist Health, Babylist Money, NYC and LA showrooms, branded content, and more — generating $750M in revenue in 2025\. Building the generational brand in baby, Babylist is reshaping the $235B kids and baby market and helping parents feel confident, connected, and cared for at every step.


**Our Ways of Working**



Babylist is remote\-first with team members across the U.S. and Canada who move fast, think smart, and use AI as part of how they work every day — not as an experiment, as an expectation. We come together twice a year to build the relationships behind the work, and we hire people who are genuinely excited about what's possible and prove it through how they show up.


**Why You Will Love Working At Babylist**


**Our Culture**


* We work with focus and intention, then step away to recharge
* We believe in exceptional management, and we invest in the tools and the time to connect with colleagues
* We build products that positively impact millions of people's lives
* AI is part of how we work, not a side experiment. You'll have leading tools like Claude and ChatGPT from day one, with no waiting on access, so the busywork gets handled and your judgment goes where it counts


**Growth \& Development**


* Competitive pay and meaningful opportunities for career advancement
* We believe technology and data can solve hard problems
* We're committed to career progression and performance\-based advancement


**Benefits**


* Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Retirement savings plan with company matching and flexible spending accounts
* Generous paid parental leave and PTO
* Winter Wonder Week: the whole company takes a paid week off at the end of the year, whether or not you celebrate anything, so everyone's out at once and comes back refreshed
* Remote work stipend to set up your office

**Interview Integrity.** AI is part of how we work at Babylist. We expect you to use it too. Your application and interviews should still reflect you and your own thinking. We'll tell you when AI is encouraged. Misrepresentation at any stage may result in removal from consideration for this and future roles.

If you receive outreach via WhatsApp, Telegram, or a non\-Babylist email, it's not us. Verify open roles at babylist.com/careers.

title: AI Creative Lead (Remote)
description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.
   

  

 We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.
   

  

 Forbes Advisor is hiring an
 ****AI Creative Lead****
 to own the generative stack that turns approved scripts and storyboards into finished, on\-brand video and static ads. This person is two things at once: a creative with a deep understanding of direct\-response marketing, and a hands\-on operator who lives in the AI tools daily. You run the back half of our pipeline, from character\-locked stills through AI video, lip\-sync, and voiceover to editor\-ready footage, and you treat every step as a creative call as much as a technical one: what serves the story, what sells, and what will read as a real ad in the feed.
   

  

 The role reports into the Head of Creative Production and partners with our Creative Directors and Editor/Designers. You know what makes a DR ad work, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, and you know which model(s) to use and why. You can hold character, wardrobe, and continuity across a whole spot, debug a broken render instead of re\-rolling, and get renders through touchy platform filters. You have shipped AI\-generated video that ran as paid creative, and you can tell real\-ad output from output that just reads as AI.
   

  

 We are a human\-led shop that uses AI to move faster without diluting craft. You protect the craft bar rather than lowering it to what the model makes easy, and you stay current with a stack that turns over frequently, treating every tool pick as a short\-term decision.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own generation end\-to\-end for paid social and native creative: character\-locked stills, AI video, lip\-sync, and clean generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to editor\-ready footage.
* Lock base characters first, then build a still per beat that references them, holding character, wardrobe, prop, and continuity consistency across an entire spot.
* Pick the right model for each job (hero vs. volume, native\-audio vs. img\-to\-video) and keep a live view of a fast\-moving tool stack, pinning exact model versions at build time.
* Scout, test, and onboard new models and tools as the stack evolves, and retire the ones that fall behind, so the team is always working with the best available.
* Get renders through platform and category filters. Diagnose and auto\-fix a broken render once, then escalate, and keep a running swipe of safe phrasings and prompt patterns that pass.
* Operate and lightly orchestrate the tooling (fan\-out, scheduling, asset movement) so many jobs run in parallel without a person babysitting each one.
* Own the generative\-side handoff into post: deliver organized, tagged, editor\-ready clips into the DAM to the production team's standards.
* Feed the shared learnings file (format, copy, render, and legal notes per job) and read it back at the next job's start so the system compounds instead of repeating mistakes.
* Partner with the Creative Directors and copywriters to keep generated output on\-voice, on\-persona, and matched beat\-for\-beat to the script (AV sync).
* Bring a direct\-response creative eye to every job: push each render toward what sells, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, not just what looks good.
* Operate inside compliance rails for our regulated categories: no better\-drug or results claims, coverage/qualify framing, required disclosures, and honest routing. Hold generation to the same gate as the rest of the pipeline.
* Manage generative tooling spend against render volume, and give the Head of Creative Production a real monthly cost model as volume scales.
* Build reusable assets (prompt libraries, character references, templates, and workflow docs) that let editors and strategists self\-serve the routine work.


**Requirements**
* 4\+ years in creative production, motion, VFX, or content, with at least the last 1 to 2 years hands\-on in generative AI video and image production for real deliverables.
* A real grounding in direct\-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built (hook, problem, mechanism, proof, offer, and CTA) and can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished.
* Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI\-generated or AI\-assisted video and stills, with an honest account of what you made vs. what the model made, and (ideally) how it performed.
* Deep, current fluency with the generative stack: multi\-subject\-consistency image models, AI video (native\-audio and img\-to\-video), lip\-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on trade\-offs, not just tool names.
* Character and continuity discipline: you can hold a consistent character across many shots and beats, not just generate one good frame.
* Prompt and troubleshooting fluency: you can diagnose why a render broke or a character drifted and fix it deliberately, rather than re\-rolling until something lands.
* Comfort building light automation/orchestration around the tools (e.g. n8n, Gumloop, or comparable) to fan out and move assets. You don't need to be an engineer, but you're not afraid of the glue.
* A finishing eye: you know when AI output reads as a real ad vs. a tech demo, and you hold the line on craft.
* Demonstrated speed and volume in a performance, DR, or high\-output content environment. Comfortable shipping many cuts and variants a week across multiple categories.
* Comfort working inside compliance rails (regulated\-category claims, platform ad policy, partner brand guardrails).
* Strong collaboration across Creative, Production, Post, and Buying, and clear written communication for briefs, prompt docs, and learnings.
* Self\-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable in a start\-up style operating environment where the tools change under you.


****STRONG PLUSES****
* Generative video that has run as paid social or DR creative with attributable performance, not only brand or experimental work.
* Concepting or copywriting experience on DR ads, so you can improve a script or angle, not just execute it.
* Direct experience generating for regulated DR categories and getting their renders through platform filters.
* Video editing or motion/VFX background (Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci) that lets you hand editors better material and speak their language.
* Experience building reusable AI workflows for creative production: prompt libraries, character\-reference systems, Claude Projects or custom GPTs, or agentic tooling that compounds team output.
* Familiarity with DAM systems (Air, Frame.io, or comparable) and production project\-management tooling.
* Comfort reading performance dashboards (Looker, Tableau, in\-platform reporting) to close the loop between what rendered and what converted.
* A track record of picking up brand\-new tools fast and forming a real point of view on them, because this stack turns over monthly.

 This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

title: AI Creative Producer, Vertical Drama
description:
**About Zing** 




 We are a fast\-growing digital entertainment company specializing in high\-quality vertical miniseries and UGC ads for global audiences. Through innovative storytelling and audience\-driven approaches, we aim to captivate mobile\-first viewers with fast\-paced, engaging, and emotionally compelling content. Our mission is to redefine short\-form entertainment by integrating creativity, data\-driven insights, and cross\-cultural perspectives.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The AI Creative Producer, Vertical Drama owns both the creative and operational success of Zing's AI\-produced vertical drama slate, end to end. This is a hybrid director/producer role: you set the visual and storytelling direction for each series, and you also run the vendor relationships, timelines, budgets, and delivery process that get it made. You are the single point of accountability between Zing's leadership and its external AI production partners — translating scripts into production\-ready creative direction, briefing and managing AI vendors, reviewing every stage of delivery for both creative quality and operational compliance, and making sure episodes ship on time, on budget, and on brand.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Creative Direction**



* Lead AI\-powered vertical short drama projects from script breakdown through final delivery.
* Translate scripts into production\-ready visual plans: scene breakdowns, shot lists, character references, location references, style guides, and AI production requirements.
* Guide AI image and video generation; review style frames, character tests, motion tests, rough cuts, and final deliverables, and give clear, actionable notes on continuity, performance, composition, pacing, and tone.
* Strengthen episode\-level hooks, cliffhangers, reversals, and emotional escalation for 1–3 minute vertical episodes.
* Maintain visual, character, and story consistency across episodes and series.
* Supervise post\-production — editing, sound, music, subtitles, and final polish.



**Production \& Vendor Management**



* Serve as the primary point of contact between Zing and external AI production vendors and partners.
* Own project timelines, budgets, and resource/vendor allocation across multiple concurrent productions.
* Communicate creative briefs, visual references, production standards, delivery timelines, and revision notes to vendors, and hold them to Zing's technical specs (9:16 format, 1–3 min episodes) and quality benchmarks.
* Manage legal and logistical documentation, including contracts, deliverables, and release forms.
* Identify production risks, bottlenecks, and vendor concerns; propose mitigations and escalate to leadership as needed.
* Enforce SOP compliance across all productions and proactively build relationships with new top\-tier AI production vendors.



**Systems \& Continuous Improvement**



* Build repeatable AI production workflows: vendor briefing templates, character bibles, prompt guidelines, review checklists, and delivery specifications.
* Translate platform data, audience feedback, and ad performance learnings into creative and production improvements.
* Help define Zing's internal AI vertical drama production playbook and quality standards.
* Monitor emerging AI tools, trends, and vendor capabilities to keep Zing's workflows and partner network competitive.



  





**Qualifications** 




**Must\-Have** 



* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in vertical/short\-form drama production — as a director, showrunner, creative producer, or producer — with real credits in the format (not adjacent film/TV only).
* Direct working experience using AI creative tools specifically for vertical drama production, e.g. Seedance, Runway, Kling, Midjourney, Flux, ComfyUI, Pika, Luma, or similar, in an actual production pipeline (not just personal experimentation).
* Strong understanding of vertical drama structure and mechanics: hooks, reversals, cliffhangers, emotional escalation, fast\-payoff storytelling.



**Also Important** 



* Proven experience managing external vendors, production partners, or outsourced/remote production teams, ideally across several projects at once.
* Strong visual storytelling ability — framing, shot design, blocking, mood, performance direction, edit rhythm — paired with equally strong organizational and project\-management skills.
* Comfortable owning budgets, timelines, contracts, and vendor accountability, not just creative notes.
* Strong taste in commercial, female\-driven vertical drama genres: romance, fantasy, revenge, billionaire, werewolf, mafia, forbidden love, melodrama, or similar high\-retention genres.
* Familiarity with production/workflow tools such as Airtable, Notion, or Frame.io.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable managing multiple stakeholders (leadership, vendors, AI artists) at once.
* Fluent English required; Mandarin proficiency is a strong plus for coordinating with overseas AI production partners.
* Must be based in or able to work from Los Angeles.
* A portfolio or work sample — director reels, vendor briefs, visual lookbooks, storyboards, or produced vertical series — is strongly preferred.

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Engine**
 Engine is the all\-in\-one travel and spend management platform trusted by 38K\+ businesses and groups representing 1\.8M\+ travelers. We're the retailer and the rails of business travel, the fastest\-growing company in travel tech, built on a decade of proprietary technology, supply, and pricing no one else can replicate. Other travel and AI companies run on our infrastructure to book real trips, hold rates, and move payments, without building any of it themselves. We built it, AI\-forward at every layer, from how travelers book to how the rails run.
   

  

 That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025\), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026\), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026\).
   

  

 We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high\-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.
   

  

 Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.
   

  

**Your Mission**
 Create across the entire customer journey. Growth touches every stage from the first impression in a paid ad, printed asset, or event through the website, lifecycle, in\-product moments, and beyond.
   

  

 You'll own the creative that shows up across all of it and build the automation, tooling, and workflows behind a creative engine capable of producing distinctive, high\-performing, on\-brand work at scale. You'll make AI a core part of how we create while maintaining a high bar for taste, craft, and originality.
   

  

 This is a role for a creative leader who wants to
 **build as much as they lead** 
 shaping the work, the systems, and ultimately the team behind it.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* **The AI\-assisted creative engine.** 
 Design the end\-to\-end creative pipeline: workflows, prompt libraries, components, guardrails, asset databases, and tool stacks that allow us to ship high volumes of quality creative quickly. Drive real innovation in how we apply AI to stand out, and establish the QA systems that keep quality high as output scales.
* **New tools and approaches to creative production.** 
 Continuously experiment with emerging creative technology, agencies, and production models. Partner with Growth's technical resources to leverage open\-source libraries and build new capabilities that increase the speed, quality, and scale of creative production.
* **Creative as targeting.** 
 Treat creative as an audience filter and a growth lever. Build frameworks for high\-performing creative territories, connect testing insights and customer behavior to new ideas, and diagnose what's working through signals like hook rate, hold rate, conversion, and creative decay.
* **The bridge between brand and scale.** 
 Work closely with Engine's Brand team to translate creative and narrative into Engine's brand systems while finding new ways to scale performance without losing what makes the brand distinctive.
* **In\-person and experiential creative.** 
 Lead creative for events, conferences, activations, and field moments. Design experiences that make the brand felt, earn attention in the room, and create stories and assets that travel far beyond the event itself.
* **Brand\-distinctive, entertainment\-first work.** 
 Ship creative that earns its media spend: bold, memorable, and unmistakably Engine. Bring flagship ideas that break category conventions while keeping the creative pipeline fresh ahead of fatigue.
* **Testing velocity.** 
 Partner with Growth on structured testing frameworks, concept logs, and learning agendas so every cycle compounds into smarter, stronger creative.
* **The creative team.** 
 Lead and develop designers, editors, AI specialists, and producers. Set the creative bar, stay close to the work, and deploy your own craft when it counts. Build a culture that values experimentation, speed, accountability, and exceptional creative standards.

We’re a performance marketing agency for premium and luxury DTC brands. We run Meta, Google, TikTok, and Connected TV for companies where the work has to look as good as it performs. Adweek named us one of the fastest growing agencies. We’re fully remote with hubs in New York, Denver, and Toronto.

Our creative team produces performance work at volume and does it well. We need the person who gives that volume a spine: someone who defines a brand’s architecture, tells its story to the client, and leads the designers building inside it.



You’ll own brand for one of our largest accounts from day one. * Define brand architecture. Map how product lines, campaigns, and channels relate. Write the system: hierarchy, voice, visual rules, and where each applies. Hand designers something they can build inside without asking you every time.

* Connect brand and performance. Work with media and creative strategists so the brand system and the ad output move together.

* Seven or more years in brand design or art direction, with at least two directing other designers.
* A portfolio that leads with brand systems, architecture, and presentation work, not static ads.
* You’ve presented your own work to clients and held your position under pressure without getting defensive.

Act like an owner. Clarity over complexity. Serve clients’ best interest. We win together, we lose together. Data\-informed, human\-led.

title: Art Director, Apparel Graphics
description:
**Role:** Art Director
  

**Team:** Graphic Design


**Scope:** Individual Contributor, P4


**Years of Experience:** 5\+


**Location:** Ventura, CA (Hybrid)  



  

As the Art Director for Apparel Graphics, you will help shape and execute the visual direction of graphics across Patagonia apparel collections. You will translate seasonal ideas, brand storytelling and product needs into original artwork, typography, color and graphic systems that are compelling, consistent and ready for production. Working closely with product line managers, designers, developers and marketing, you will guide creative work from concept through final execution. Your ability to create meaningful, durable graphics and explore responsible applications will support Patagonia’s work to save our home planet.


**What You’ll Do**

* Create and art direct seasonal apparel graphics that express Patagonia’s brand identity, product stories and creative point of view across assigned categories.
* Translate seasonal themes and creative briefs into original artwork, typography, color strategies, trims and cohesive graphic concepts.
* Partner with Product Line Management, apparel designers, development and marketing teams to align graphics with product, brand, production and sales timelines.
* Balance hands\-on design with art direction, providing clear feedback to internal designers, external creatives and agency or freelance partners as assigned.
* Prepare artwork for screen print, embroidery and specialty applications, working with graphic development partners to ensure creative intent, quality and production feasibility.
* Review and approve artwork strike\-offs and revisions, resolving creative or technical issues while keeping work on schedule.
* Support artist commissioning, artwork licensing and related cost discussions when projects require external creative partners.
* Research cultural, artistic, market and competitive influences while protecting Patagonia’s brand heritage and avoiding trend\-for\-trend’s\-sake design.
* Explore opportunities to improve materials, techniques and graphic applications with consideration for quality, longevity and environmental impact.
* Present concepts and creative rationale clearly, manage multiple projects and maintain consistent communication throughout the design process.

**Who You Are**

* **Conceptual** : You can turn an open\-ended theme or product story into a clear, original visual idea.
* **Hands\-On** : You enjoy making the work as much as guiding it and can move comfortably between concept, design and refinement.
* **Collaborative** : You build trust across creative, product and development partners and use feedback to strengthen the work.
* **Discerning** : You bring strong taste and judgment in illustration, typography, color, composition and brand expression.
* **Practical** : You understand that successful creative work must also meet production, quality, cost and timeline requirements.
* **Curious** : You stay connected to art, culture, apparel and emerging creative practices while maintaining an authentic brand perspective.
* **Clear** : You communicate creative intent, feedback and decisions in ways that help others move the work forward.
* **Mission\-Aligned** : You care about responsible design, product longevity and Patagonia’s purpose to save our home planet.

**Experience You Bring**

* 5\+ years of apparel graphics, graphic design, art direction or closely related creative experience, with a portfolio demonstrating concept development and successful final execution.
* Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, fine art, industrial arts or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and other relevant design tools.
* Strong capabilities in original artwork, illustration, typography, color strategy and visual storytelling.
* Working knowledge of apparel graphics production, including screen print, embroidery, trims, specialty applications and artwork preparation.
* Experience partnering with product creation or development teams and responding to technical, cost, quality and timeline constraints.
* Experience art directing or providing creative feedback to internal or external designers, illustrators or artists.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast\-moving, collaborative environment.
* Experience with outdoor, sport, lifestyle or global consumer brands is preferred.
* Familiarity with responsible design practices, innovative art applications, artist licensing or outdoor communities is a plus.

**Hiring Range** : $122,900 \- $140,000 USD Annual

Patagonia offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, retirement and leave of absence plans. Benefit plans may vary slightly depending on the nature of your employment.

title: Studio Director
description:

We bring architecture, design, and construction under one roof, with a strong emphasis on technology, speed, and craft.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Studio Director** 
 to lead an entire studio across client management, contracts, design, technical coordination, and delivery. This is a senior leadership role for someone who can operate as a broad\-based leader rather than a narrow specialist, someone who can move between client conversations, project strategy, technical issues, team leadership, and day\-to\-day studio needs with ease.
   

  

 This role is intended to be more of a multi\-tool leadership position: a person who can talk about contracts, deal with clients, guide design, engage technical and CA issues, and help support the Managing Principal lead the full studio. The Studio Director will directly lead our Project Managers and Project Architects, who are responsible for BIM model development, construction documentation, and permit\-ready deliverables in Revit. You will set the design intent and quality bar that the team documents and executes against, review their work at key milestones, and serve as the design authority they escalate to on coordination, code, and client\-facing design decisions.

* 13\+ years of professional experience in architecture, residential design\-build, or a comparable studio environment

* 5\+ years in a senior leadership role spanning client management, contracts, team oversight, and project execution
* Residential experience, especially custom homes, ADUs, and rebuild work
* Proven ability to lead across contracts, client management, design discussions, technical coordination, and CA

* Experience overseeing teams, projects, and multiple stakeholder relationships

title: Senior Director, AI Transformation & Operations
description:
The Senior Director of AI Transformation \& Operations serves as the operational heart of the ELEC AI Center of Excellence.
  

  

This is a high\-impact leadership role responsible for translating our enterprise\-wide AI strategy into reality.
  

  

You will provide the structure, shared foundations, and governance that enable our four business lines to deliver AI solutions with speed, quality, and precision.
**Job Description**
===================


**The mission of the AI Operations Leader within our office is to:**


* **Enable Execution:** Facilitate the execution of Business Line long\-term strategy (LTS) plans, ensuring they move at speed and with high impact.
* **Ensure Operational Excellence:** Define and manage the day\-to\-day mechanisms that deliver consistent quality, ensuring that every AI initiative is executed with discipline and minimal risk.
* **Scale Through Capability:** Act as the operational backbone of our center of excellence, transforming our strategy into repeatable processes that allow our businesses to own and scale their AI delivery effectively.

**What you’ll be doing**


* **Facilitating business execution:** You will act as the primary partner for our four business lines. Your focus is on clearing the path for them to execute their long\-term strategic AI plans, ensuring they have the support and resources needed to reach their goals quickly and effectively.
* **Defining the operational heartbeat:** You will establish the "cadence" of AI delivery—regular reviews, progress tracking, and feedback loops—that keep our business lines aligned and moving forward.
* **Providing a shared foundation:** You will lead the development of the "common ground"—the standards, tools, and shared platforms—that allow our business units to build AI solutions without having to solve the same infrastructure or governance problems in isolation.
* **Driving speed and quality:** You will help our business teams balance the need for rapid delivery with the need for high\-quality, reliable output. By implementing clear, lightweight ways of working, you will help teams avoid common pitfalls and keep projects on track.
* **Managing risk by design:** Instead of treating risk as a hurdle to be jumped at the end, you will help teams bake it into their processes from day one. You will ensure that Responsible AI and security practices are built into the workflow, protecting the business while maintaining momentum.
* **Ensuring strategic alignment:** You will oversee our portfolio to ensure that the work happening across the business lines stays tethered to ELEC’s overarching enterprise priorities. You will help teams focus their energy on the initiatives that provide the greatest return.
* **Supporting the transition:** We are working toward a future where our business lines are fully empowered to lead their own AI delivery. You will guide this evolution, scaling our efforts today to build a sustainable, business\-led model for 2030\.
* **Driving adoption and upskilling:** You will champion the human side of our transformation by leading efforts to upskill our workforce. In close coordination with ELEC HR, the GE Vernova Corporate Learning team, the ELEC CTO office, and Business Line AI teams, you will design and adapt training programs that directly address the unique missions and practical needs of our ELEC teams. By building targeted AI literacy and specialized expertise, you will ensure our people are empowered to adopt new tools and maximize the value of AI in their specific daily work.

**What you bring to the team**


* **A commitment to partnership:** You have a track record of supporting business units in achieving their strategic goals. You view your role as a service to the business lines, not as a central authority.
* **A "get it done" mindset:** You understand that the best strategy is only valuable if it can be executed. You are experienced in guiding complex initiatives through to delivery while maintaining high standards.
* **Balanced judgment:** You know how to provide enough guidance to ensure consistency across the company without creating unnecessary red tape that slows teams down.
* **Technical and business fluency:** You can communicate clearly with both technical delivery teams and business leadership, ensuring that everyone understands the goals and the path to achieving them.
* **Proven reliability:** You have a history of managing programs or operations where speed, quality, and risk management were all critical to success.

**How we’ll measure success**


* **LTS Execution:** Our business lines are successfully hitting the milestones set out in their long\-term AI strategy plans.
* **Operational Speed:** We have reduced the time it takes to get from an idea to a working, value\-driving solution.
* **Risk \& Quality:** Our AI initiatives consistently meet our internal standards for security and responsibility, with minimal friction.
* **Business Impact:** Every AI project we support can clearly demonstrate its contribution to ELEC’s business performance.

**Skills \& Academic Requirements**


To lead this transformation effectively, you will need a blend of technical understanding, operational discipline, and the ability to influence people.


* **Academic \& Professional Background:**
	+ **Degree:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
	+ **Experience:** Strong and proven leadership experience in operations, program management, or technical strategy, ideally within a large, global matrixed organization.
	+ **AI/Technical Fluency:** A solid grasp of the AI/ML landscape—not necessarily as a developer, but as a leader who understands the lifecycle of AI solutions, from data preparation to production and monitoring.
* **Core Competencies:**
	+ **Strategic Change Management:** Proven success in leading large\-scale organizational shifts, including the ability to build and sustain engagement across diverse teams.
	+ **Operational Discipline:** Exceptional ability to build, manage, and refine the "cadence" of a business—tracking metrics, managing budgets, and maintaining project momentum.
	+ **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Demonstrated expertise in bridging the gap between technical teams (CTO/Engineering) and business stakeholders. You know how to translate technical requirements into business value and vice\-versa.
	+ **Learning \& Development Agility:** A strong track record of partnering with HR and Learning \& Development functions to design curriculum or enablement programs. You understand that "upskilling" is not just about classroom training, but about driving behavioral change.
	+ **Influencing \& Negotiation:** The ability to achieve alignment across different business lines without having direct line authority over every team member. You lead through persuasion, shared goals, and the value you provide.
	+ **Risk \& Governance Mindset:** A pragmatic approach to compliance and ethics. You can integrate guardrails into the development process so that they feel like an asset rather than an obstacle.

title: Associate Applied (AI) Value Engineer (Nordics) - Orbit Program
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. **Start date: 1st of February 2027\.**


### **Role Description**



As an Applied (AI) Value Engineer you are pushing the envelope in solving business\-critical problems for our customers. You are part of our Value Engineering team and are the trusted advisor for customers working on the intersection of technology and business. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world's leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis' Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers' business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Executives and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization in order to increase the footprint of Celonis at those customers.


### **Launch Your Enterprise Software Career \- Orbit Graduate program**



Kickstart your career in enterprise software through our immersive 12\-month Orbit Program.



During the Orbit Graduate program, you will be joining the Global VE Center of Excellence which is an international, diverse, and dynamic organization at the core of the Celonis Value Engineering team supporting our local field teams. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast\-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to an international community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is one based on building trust, continuous development, and improvement through coaching \& mentoring.



This program offers a unique blend of client engagements, dedicated mentorship, and a strong team culture where collaboration and shared success are paramount. You'll leverage your technical background to develop essential skills, build lasting client relationships, and establish yourself as a trusted advisor, paving the way for significant career growth within Celonis.



Your journey begins with comprehensive onboarding and enablement, followed by hands\-on experience in customer engagements and targeted training. You will gain expertise in:

### **What You Need:**

* Excellent academic performance
* Extensive internship experience or 1\-2 years of full\-time work experience. Ideally at the intersection of business and technology.

* Confidence in presenting to diverse audiences.
* A proactive approach to problem\-solving, with a willingness to learn from mistakes.

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and execute on deadlines.
* Excellent communication skills and **fluency in English and at least one Nordic language (Finnish, Danish, Norwegian, Swedish, etc.).**

**Bonus Points:**

* Customer\-facing, customer success/service, or sales experience.
* Hands\-on experience with technical Proof of Concept projects
* Hands\-on experience building agentic systems using LLM orchestration, RAG, function calling, and prompt engineering

* Supply Chain process experience (Procurement, Order Management, Inventory Management, Production).
* Experience modeling ROI and TCO for business case justification.

 **What Celonis can offer you:**

* Ownership from Day 1: Every full\-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit\-based refresh grants.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI\-driven processes. description:
#### **About Stark**


Stark builds the world’s most powerful electric motorcycles. From the VARG MX to the road\-legal VARG EX \& SM, our bikes have won world championships and are engineered to outperform anything with a combustion engine.


We’re based in Sant Boi, Barcelona, growing fast (77% year\-on\-year), and building a team that will take us even further. If you want to work on a product that people are genuinely obsessed with, this is it.


Stark will become the global market leader in premium motorcycles. Building premium motorcycles requires innovation and we need your help to make us succeed


Our mission is to lead the way towards a sustainable motorcycle industry, by reducing plastic and CO2 pollution.


This will be achieved by building sustainable products that are superior to traditional technology in terms of Performance, Emotion and Design.

#### **The Role**


This isn't just a procurement role; it is a strategic position requiring a deep understanding of the global electronics ecosystem. You will be responsible for navigating the complexities of semiconductor cycles, managing relationships with top\-tier manufacturers, and identifying technical opportunities within our designs to optimize the supply chain.


You will report directly to the Purchasing Director and work as a bridge between Engineering and the global market to ensure our motorcycles remain at the cutting edge of electric performance.

#### **What You’ll Do**

* **Strategic Sourcing:** Navigate the global electronics manufacturing supplier landscape (EMS, Electronic Components Manufacturers \& Worldwide Electronics Distributors) to secure best\-in\-class partnerships.
* **Market Intelligence:** Act as the internal expert on semiconductor trends, memory market volatility, and global supply/demand shifts to proactively mitigate risk.
* **Technical Portfolio Discovery:** Review internal designs and technical portfolios to identify new manufacturers and alternative components (pin\-to\-pin or functional equivalents) that offer better lead times or cost\-efficiency.
* **Relationship Management:** Build and leverage high\-level relationships with major component manufacturers and global distributors
* **Commercial Ownership:** Manage RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs; negotiate Master Purchase Agreements that protect Stark’s agility in a volatile market.
* **Cost \& Inventory Control:** Drive aggressive cost\-reduction activities and "total cost of ownership" models without compromising the technical integrity of our assemblies.
* **Cross\-Functional Engineering Support:** Act as a technical consultant to the Engineering team during the design phase to ensure "design\-for\-availability."

#### **What you will bring to Stark**

* **Experience:** Minimum of 5 years of senior sourcing experience, specifically focused on **Electronic Components and** **assemblies.**
* **Education:** **Electronics Engineer** (highly valuable) or a technical degree with significant experience in electronics manufacturing.
* **Global Landscape Expertise:** Deep knowledge of the global semiconductor players (Texas Instruments, STMicroelectronics, NXP, Analog Devices, Rohm, Infineon, Murata, etc.) and the wider distribution network.
* **Technical Discernment:** The ability to read a schematic or BOM and detect opportunities for supplier diversification or technical optimization.
* **Negotiation Prowess:** A skilled negotiator who understands the nuances of the electronics industry, from NRE costs to volume rebates and buffer stock agreements.
* **Mindset:** Results\-oriented, highly analytical, and passionate about sustainability.
* **Communication:** Fluent in English (must) and Spanish (highly desired).

#### **Why work with us?**

* The chance to work on a product people are genuinely passionate about
* A fast\-growing company with real momentum
* A creative, international team based in Barcelona
* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Direct access to riders, race teams, and the product — this is not a remote\-from\-the\-product role
* Subsidized lunch in our in house restaurant
* Free access to our in\-house gym (including weekends!)
* 30 days of paid vacation

**At Stark, we don’t just accept difference—we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community.**


We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, neurodiversity, or disability, feels a true sense of belonging. We believe that diverse teams make better decisions and that a culture of equity is a prerequisite for innovation.

**Accessibility:** If you require any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process (such as assistive technology, extra time, or a specific format), please let us know at HR@starkfuture.com. We are here to support you.


We encourage applications from underrepresented groups and are excited to see how your unique perspective can help us grow

Dow Jones is seeking an AI Engineer/Solutions Specialist to join our Automation \& Reporting team. You will design, construct, integrate and maintain AI Solutions into the existing and new workflows to optimize processes across our B2B Risk and Research teams. As a key team member, you will be involved in every aspect of the data science project development process, from data analysis and model selection to building proofs of concept and refining pipelines. You will leverage your expertise in statistical analysis and machine learning techniques to derive insights from data, address the organization's needs, and deliver tangible value through actionable outcomes. You will report to the Director, Automation \& Reporting.


**You Will:**


* **Solution Design \& Development:** Own the development, deployment, and maintenance of machine learning models and LLM based solutions that automate business workflows and enhance reporting capabilities. Apply NLP and information retrieval techniques to extract structured information from unstructured text content.
* **Data Engineering \& Pipeline Management:** Build and maintain robust data pipelines that support high\-volume data processing, enrichment, and model training utilizing Python, SQL, and cloud services. Analyze, clean, and preprocess large datasets to optimize reusable ML models.
* **Stakeholder \& Portfolio Management:** Collaborate cross\-functionally with business, product, and engineering teams. Elicit requirements from stakeholders, define business problems, and translate them into well\-scoped, technical solutions.
* **Cloud \& AI Integration:** Leverage external APIs (including LLM APIs) for advanced data enrichment, preprocessing, or model integration. Deploy models and automation tools seamlessly using cloud\-based services (AWS and GCP).

* **Essential Experience:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related STEM field). 3\+ years of experience in a data science or applied ML role with a strong dual focus on both modeling and pipeline development.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Exceptional programming skills in Python and hands\-on experience with standard machine learning libraries (e.g., scikit\-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, or PyTorch), alongside modern AI frameworks and SDKs (such as LangChain or LlamaIndex). Proven experience designing, building, and deploying AI agents to automate complex workflows. Experience writing and optimizing complex SQL queries and handling large datasets. Familiarity with version control (Git) and reproducible workflows (e.g., notebooks, scripts, containers).
* **Cloud \& API Expertise:** Hands\-on experience deploying and managing workloads within cloud infrastructure (preferably AWS, including tools like S3, Glue, Lambda, and Athena). Proven experience securely working with APIs, including integrating LLM APIs or external data sources.

description:
Mercury is the European leader in construction solutions.



We build and manage complex engineering \& construction projects for the world’s leading corporations. Our solutions help deliver technologies and life changing advancements that connect people, communities, and businesses, giving them the power to achieve incredible things. Our people have the courage to be innovative. Their determination and sharp focus enable us to deliver with certainty, time and time again.



We deliver our clients’ visions through leading edge construction solutions across multiple sectors, including Enterprise Data Centres, Advanced Technology \& Life Sciences, Hyperscale Data Centres, Fire Protection.



At Mercury, it is our duty to encourage and back our people to realise their vision of themselves. We place them at the heart of what we do, providing challenging opportunities to develop within a great team in a supportive environment that allows them to reach their full potential.

  


**Key Responsibilities of the Role:**


* Management of the Electrical Systems package and leadership of all electrical construction activities on site.
* Management of the OFCI / Main Capital electrical equipment and packages.
* Management of all day\-to\-day site operations relating to the electrical scope and interfaces with other trades.
* Ensure Mercury policies and procedures are followed closely.
* Familiarisation with Design/IFC specifications and drawings to fully understand the scope of the project works.
* Management of Site Safety in conjunction with the Project Manager and the Mercury Safety Advisor, including the setup, management and closing out of the safety file as part of the Management team.
* Ensure all work activities are planned to the required level of detail, with all documentation in line with company SOPs (RAMS, SPAs, Permits) and approved at the workface.
* Ensure all work is delivered in accordance with the permitting requirements of Mercury's Electrical Safety Rules and all applicable Safe Systems of Work.
* Ensure compliance with COHE and the Operating \& Energisation Procedures for LV \& MV systems, including arc flash awareness and controls.
* Oversee the room permits process and ensure contractors on site are compliant with requirements.
* Drive a focused Quality, Health, Safety and Environmental (QEHS) culture within your team and subcontractors, and drive the Mercury Engineering culture of safety and quality through the project.
* Ensure all EHS alerts are communicated effectively and understood by the team, and engage in campaigns including TBTs, stand\-downs, demonstrations and safety initiatives.
* Issue weekly safety stats and project labour projections.
* Management of Site QA in conjunction with the Mercury QA Manager, including set up, management and close out of the QA file, and review of contractor QAQC documentation and site performance.
* Ensure works are installed in accordance with project specifications and to the Project QA plan (e.g. pre\-agreed benchmarking).
* Review drawings and setting\-out details.
* Review quality of output and foster a culture of continuous improvement, implementing corrective actions where required.
* Manage and oversee the quality inspection regime, ensuring subcontractors carry out and maintain all quality inspections, ITPs, RFTs and snag closure as part of their scope, and hold them accountable for completing and submitting these on time and in line with the Project QA plan.
* Management of the electrical design process in conjunction with the Design Manager.
* Oversee the coordination process to transform design information into full installation drawings via BIM personnel, ensuring spec compliance and schedule priority.
* Manage the generation and close\-out of RFIs and technical queries, value engineering initiatives and design risk management.
* Management of the Project Schedule in conjunction with the Mercury Project Manager, Planner, consulting Engineer and Client requirements, including weekly progress updates.
* Ensure all site works are planned according to site production control requirements (Visilean or other collaborative planning).
* Drive digital collaborative planning and Lean construction processes to ensure effective coordination, efficient execution of works and timely delivery of milestones.
* Use project lookaheads to drive delivery and resource planning.
* Schedule material deliveries to correspond with the project schedule and track all deliveries.
* Management of all costs associated with your package including: Mercury Electrical Team; Sub\-contractors; Material deliveries and goods receipting; Plant and Equipment; Variations; Valuations.
* Own the commercial performance of the package, ensuring timely identification, management and recovery of variations, claims and commercial risks.
* Ensure subcontractor invoicing is measured in accordance with agreed progress milestones.
* Ensure Material Take\-Offs (MTOs) are completed and reviewed against subcontractor pricing returns and procurement budgets.
* Prepare Sub\-contract and Supplier Tender Packages in conjunction with the Project QS.
* Ensure subcontractors used have been vetted and approved by Mercury Procurement before use.
* Issue weekly cost reports, including all orders placed, materials expected and labour levels.
* Management of sub\-contractor activities including tracking progress against schedule and manpower levels. Ensure there is a weekly minuted meeting with sub\-contractors.
* Monitor that subcontractors have sufficiently resourced the project to maintain programme delivery.
* Management of the Mercury "In Progress" snagging system, ensuring supervisors return weekly punch lists where applicable, and ensure all snags are distributed to and closed out by all sub\-contractors.
* Maintain an active risk register and implement mitigation measures, highlighting any risk elements within Mercury's control (e.g. late deliveries).
* Implement the Mercury Project Audit Plan, review weekly audits and address open items with your team.
* Drive closure of all open audit actions within agreed timelines and communicate findings clearly to all stakeholders.
* Capture and act on lessons learned.
* Issue direct labour hours and sub\-contractor hours to the time administrator for tracking centrally.
* Issue an internal weekly progress report rolled up from project supervisors' reports, highlighting percentage complete based on WBS codes and any concerns or risks within Mercury's control.
* Issue an external weekly progress report to the Project Manager, highlighting areas not available, delays, shortage of design, third\-party hold\-ups and percentage complete.
* Attendance at Site Meetings, Internal Project Reviews, Engineering Reviews, Planning and Co\-ordination Meetings and Handover Meetings.
* Attend morning whiteboard meetings and evening planning/schedule review meetings.
* Maintain a weekly project photographic diary.
* Support and coach all the electrical team to ensure their development, which is crucial to our organisation and industry, supporting succession planning and team development.
* Set training requirements for Mercury and subcontractor staff and ensure appropriate training is available and completed.
* Direct management of the Mercury Engineering project team, including alignment of all discipline leads to the benefit of project goals.
* Drive the commissioning of all electrical equipment, taking ownership of completing the Red Tag (L2A – Installation) and Yellow Tag (L2B – Ready for Energisation) with all checklists and test documentation uploaded and approved in CxDE, then support the final commissioning levels — L3 Start\-Up (Green Tag), L4 Functional Performance Testing and Integrated System Testing (IST) — ensuring the electrical team and subcontractors deliver each level on time, to the required quality, and to CxA sign\-off.
* Close out of all project items including Final Account, O \& M Manuals, Punch List, Safety File, QA File, Material and Plant re\-locations and Project Plan – all with the support of the site Project Manager and your project team.
* All other duties associated with the role.

  


**Essential Criteria for the Role:**

* Overall 10\-15\+ years of experience in the construction sector.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Electrical, construction management, or other relevant degree.
* Minimum 5 years previous experience in Project Management
* Proven record of coordinating and managing large installation projects
* Experience dealing with Industrial Relations issues
* Knowledge of Health \& Safety
* Experienced in design and build
* Good technical knowledge of both Electrical and Mechanical systems
* Excellent IT skills
* Excellent communication skills
* Ability to work well within strict deadlines
* Ability to drive a large\-scale project

title: ITSM & Vendor Management Specialist
description:
Job Description:
* We are your **Energy Technology Partner**. We electrify, automate, and digitalize every industry, business, and home, driving efficiency and sustainability for all.

  

At Schneider Electric, our values – IMPACT (Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork) – are the foundation of everything we do. Becoming an Impact Maker means turning sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization.

  

Are you ready to lead the digital transformation to create a more sustainable world?


If you are up to challenge your creativity and make an impact, we are excited to welcome you!

 **Schneider Digital** is the digital department of Schneider Electric, leading the digital transformation in the company by giving support globally to our internal teams and our clients. Schneider Digital consists of 6 Digital Hubs worldwide which are strategically located to ensure a 24/7 support across the company (France, China, India, USA, Mexico and Spain). Our Digital Hub in Barcelona is formed by \+450 employees working in strategic projects and different roles such as Data, Cybersecurity, ERP, Cloud, Infrastructures, IT Project Management or Digital Marketing.

  

Schneider Electric is a Fortune 500 global enterprise operating a product\-oriented infrastructure model structured around technical pillars (Network, Compute \& Storage, Cloud, Automation, Monitoring) and supported by a broad ecosystem of strategic vendors. This model enables specialization and execution at scale, but also creates fragmentation risks across prioritization, standards, financial control, vendor management, and service performance.

  

To address these risks, the Global Infrastructure Service Delivery (GISD) is establishing a Transversal Governance Team whose mission is to govern, assure, standardize, prioritize, and escalate — not to become a second operations organization or a reporting factory. Governance defines direction and control; pillars retain delivery ownership.


The ITSM \& Vendor Management Specialist is a hybrid, high\-impact role that bridges service performance (ITSM) discipline with strategic vendor oversight. The role ensures enterprise\-first outcomes, actionable transparency, and effective cross\-functional integration with Procurement, Finance, Legal, Security, Enterprise Architecture, and the GTS PMO.

  

While this role combines responsibilities across both ITSM and Vendor Management, we are not seeking a deep subject matter expert in every area. We are looking for a professional with solid experience in one or both disciplines, strong learning agility, adaptability to change, and a willingness to grow alongside a newly established Governance Team.

This is a governance\-focused position rather than a hands\-on infrastructure operations role. The successful candidate will influence outcomes through collaboration, service governance, performance management, and stakeholder engagement across multiple technical pillars. **What will you do?**

 **Key Responsibilities**

 **A. ITSM / Service Performance, Quality \& Continuous Improvement**

* Own and publish the consolidated Infrastructure KPI / SLA Dashboard and monthly Infrastructure Availability \& Reliability Report (uptime, MTTR, MTBF, unplanned downtime), ensuring data quality, actionable insights, and timely reporting across all pillars. Maintain the Major Incident \& Post\-Mortem Register (P1/P2\), driving root\-cause analysis governance and preventive\-action follow\-through.
* Enforce observability and ITSM process standards (incident, problem, change, request, knowledge) across ServiceNow.
* Drive Continuous Service Improvement (CSI) initiatives, tracking benefit realization and presenting outcomes to leadership.
* Govern aggregate service health; partner with pillar operations teams which remain accountable for instrumenting their domains.

**B. Vendor \& Contract Management**

* Produce Vendor Performance Scorecards and coordinate Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (BRs) for strategic vendors, assessing SLA attainment, delivery quality, responsiveness, strategic alignment, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Act as the single point of governance for assigned strategic vendor relationships, fostering executive engagement while surfacing risks, issues, and opportunities to Infrastructure leadership.
* Operate the SLA Breach \& Remediation Tracker, driving vendor accountability, corrective\-action plans, penalty/credit follow\-up, and escalation of material service issues.
* Support RFPs, sourcing events, contract negotiations, and renewal planning in partnership with Procurement and Legal, ensuring auditable sourcing decisions and preventing unfavorable auto\-renewals.
* Identify vendor consolidation, optimization, and cost\-efficiency opportunities across the supplier portfolio, supporting financial, operational, and strategic objectives.

(External) English Qualifications:
**What qualifications will make you successful for this role?**

 **Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related discipline.
* 6–8\+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, governance, service management, vendor management, or related technology functions, including exposure to ITSM and/or vendor governance activities.
* Proven ability to collaborate across complex organizations, influence stakeholders without direct authority, and build alignment across cross\-functional teams.
* ITIL v4 Foundation certification required.
* Hands\-on expertise with ServiceNow (ITSM, ITOM, modules).
* Proven track record defining SLAs/KPIs and building executive\-grade dashboards (Tableau strongly preferred).
* Solid contract lifecycle management experience: drafting input, renewals, SLA enforcement, exit clauses.
* Demonstrated experience negotiating with and managing hyperscalers and tier\-1 infrastructure vendors (Cisco, Microsoft, AWS, Broadcom, AT\&T, or equivalent).
* Financial acumen: TCO, CapEx vs OpEx, chargeback/showback, cost optimization.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills working with global teams in Procurement, Finance, Legal, Security, and pillar architecture/operations leads.
* Excellent written and executive\-level verbal communication in English.
* Analytical, data\-driven, and outcome\-oriented mindset; comfortable challenging stakeholders constructively.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* COBIT 2019, ISO/IEC 20000, or IAOP Certified Outsourcing Professional (COP).
* Foundational level of knowledge of ServiceNow (SNOW).
* FinOps Certified Practitioner.
* Prior experience in Fortune 500 / multinational infrastructure environments.

**Key Stakeholders \& Interfaces**

* Head of Infrastructure / Infrastructure Services Director
* Pillar Leads (Network, Compute \& Storage, Cloud, Automation, Monitoring)
* Pillar Operations Teams
* Procurement
* Legal
* Finance Business Partners
* GTS PMO (Project Management Organization)
* Service Desk
* Strategic Vendors (Cisco, Microsoft, AWS, Broadcom, AT\&T, etc.)
* Sustainability Leads

**Success Metrics / KPIs (First 12 Months)**

* 100% of tier\-1 vendor QBRs executed on schedule with documented outcomes.
* On\-time monthly delivery of the consolidated KPI/SLA Dashboard with \> 95% data quality.
* Master Vendor Portfolio Register kept fully current with monthly refresh cycles.
* Demonstrable cost savings via renegotiation, consolidation, or optimization (target: 3–5% of in\-scope contract value).
* Measurable improvement of MTTR on P1/P2 incidents vs prior baseline.

 **What will you get?**

  

We adapt to you:


 With our flexible schedule, you'll have the freedom to adjust your work hours to accommodate your personal needs and responsibilities.


 We know how great it is to work from home. With our hybrid work plan, you can enjoy working from the comfort of your home.


 Need more time to relax and disconnect? With our Holy Pack, you can purchase additional vacation days to recharge when you need it most.


 Celebrate holidays your way! With Floating Holidays, you can exchange holidays for other days that better suit your plans and personal preferences.


‍Need additional time to explore new experiences or focus on personal projects? With the Sabbatical Pack, you can request up to 2 months of extra leave (unpaid).


 We value the importance of family and want to support you in all aspects of your life. Our Global Family Leave Policy provides flexible paid conditions for when you need it most, whether you're about to be a parent, need time to overcome a loss, or to care for a loved one.

  

We take care of you:


 With access to the health and wellness platform Wellwo, you and up to 5 people of your choice can enjoy access to wellness content, nutrition counseling, fitness classes, and more!


‍From dance classes to booking a hotel spa, we offer an agreement with Wellhub so you can access a network of thousands of gyms and sports centers to keep your body active in the way you like best.


 Your well\-being is our priority. You will have medical service at your workplace for close attention to any medical needs.

  

We empower you:


 With Career Hub, our AI\-driven professional development platform, you can connect with job opportunities, projects, and mentors at Schneider Electric globally.


 We offer you the opportunity to be a shareholder of Schneider Electric and share in our achievements with our stock ownership program.


 We celebrate everyone's talent and success with our recognition program, through which you can give and receive points for your achievements and redeem them for gift cards at your favorite stores.


 You will have life insurance for your protection.


 We offer you a Flexible Remuneration Plan in which you can choose from a variety of options, such as health insurance, meal vouchers, childcare vouchers, transportation vouchers, training, and more.


 With Club Schneider, you will enjoy special discounts at your favorite stores, restaurants, travel agencies, and other external services.


 Participate in company\-subsidized volunteer programs to contribute to our community and have a positive impact on your environment.

  

Let us know about you, apply today!

title: Excellence & Execution Head

In this pivotal leadership role, you will shape how Novartis delivers excellence across customer engagement, insight generation, digital transformation, field effectiveness, and organizational capability development. You will anticipate market and ecosystem shifts, translate global strategies into impactful local execution, and continuously elevate execution standards through external benchmarking, innovation, and operational excellence.


You will lead a high\-performing organization spanning five core capabilities:

* Field Excellence
* Integrated Insights
* Data, Analytics \& Platforms (DAP)
* Capability Building
* Customer Excellence

  

Together, these teams enable superior execution, optimized resource allocation, enhanced customer experiences, and sustainable business performance across the portfolio.

**Key Responsibilities**

### **Integrated Insights**

* Ensure trusted, high\-quality business\-critical data and reporting capabilities across functions.
* Drive standardization of tools, processes, and data governance frameworks.
* Enable adoption of AI\-powered solutions and advanced analytics platforms.
* Manage business readiness and deployment of global execution excellence initiatives and technology platforms.
* Foster digital, technology, and AI capability development across the organization.

### **Capability Building**

* Build and deploy world\-class capabilities across Marketing, Sales, Medical Affairs, and Value \& Access.
* Assess future capability requirements based on strategic priorities and evolving industry trends.
* Deliver impactful learning journeys, curricula, and development programs.
* Establish standards for learning governance, effectiveness measurement, and capability outcomes.
* Partner with global teams and external vendors to deliver innovative learning experiences.

### **Customer Excellence**

* Drive integrated customer engagement excellence across Commercial and Value \& Access organizations.
* Lead omnichannel strategy activation and customer journey optimization.
* Ensure launch readiness through robust planning, orchestration, execution, and continuous improvement processes.
* Optimize content deployment, customer engagement strategies, and promotional excellence frameworks.
* Coordinate congresses, strategic events, and customer engagement initiatives.
* Drive implementation of global frameworks including ICE, IpEx, and launch excellence programs.

### **Leadership \& Culture**

* Lead, inspire, and develop a diverse team of execution excellence professionals.
* Foster a high\-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Build strong succession pipelines and future leadership capabilities.
* Drive transformation through Novartis Leadership Expectations and a growth mindset culture.
* Role model the highest standards of ethics, integrity, compliance, and patient focus.

**Essential Requirements**
--------------------------

### **Education**

* University degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Biosciences, or a related field.
* Advanced degree preferred.

### **Experience**

* Extensive leadership experience (typically 12\+ years) within the pharmaceutical industry, consulting, FMCG, or related sectors.
* Proven track record leading commercial organizations, business transformation, or execution excellence functions.
* Experience working across multiple execution excellence capabilities such as analytics, field operations, customer excellence, digital transformation, capability building, or market insights.
* Demonstrated success leading complex change initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders without formal authority.
* Experience operating in highly matrixed, cross\-functional environments.

### **Skills \& Expertise**

* Advanced strategic thinking, analytical, forecasting, and insight\-generation capabilities.
* Expertise in digital transformation, technology adoption, AI enablement, and data\-driven decision\-making.

* Excellent project management, prioritization, and organizational effectiveness skills.

As the voice of the Italian market, this person will ensure local customer insights and business priorities are reflected across marketing initiatives.

### **Market Ownership \& Leadership**


* Own Consumer Marketing performance for the Italian market (Matrimonio.com).
* Act as the primary marketing representative for Italy in cross\-functional planning and decision\-making.
* Champion local market needs and ensure they are reflected in campaign strategy and execution.
* Build strong relationships with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Sales, and other business functions.

### **Campaign Management**


* Lead end\-to\-end campaign management, from briefing and planning through execution, optimization, and post\-campaign analysis.
* Own the Italian campaign calendar, ensuring campaigns are delivered on time and meet quality and localization standards.
* Coordinate campaign localization to ensure messaging resonates with the Italian audience.

* Ensure campaigns are delivered efficiently, within budget, and aligned with brand and performance goals.
* Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities for optimization throughout execution.

* Partner closely with Paid Media, CRM, Social, Editorial, Creative, Product, B2B, and other marketing teams to deliver integrated campaigns.
