title: Publicity Manager
description:
***Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.***

**Who We Are…**

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the *storytellers* bringing our characters to life, the *creators* bringing them to your living rooms and the *dreamers* creating what’s next…


From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

**Your New Role...**
Join Warner Bros. Pictures and play a pivotal role in shaping and delivering publicity campaigns for the theatrical slate in Spain. Working closely with the Senior Director of Publicity, Italy and Spain, you will ensure campaigns are culturally relevant, aligned with international objectives, and generate meaningful audience engagement and earned media impact.
If you are passionate about entertainment publicity, thrive in a fast\-paced environment and enjoy working across high\-profile film releases, we would love to hear from you.**Your Role Accountabilities*** Oversee Spanish publicity campaigns from strategy through execution, localising global plans to maximise relevance and impact within the Spanish market while identifying creative opportunities that drive earned media coverage and audience engagement.
* Act as the primary publicity contact for Spain, partnering with cross\-functional teams across Marketing, Distribution, Creative, Social, Media and Promotions, while coordinating relationships with filmmakers, talent teams and external PR agencies.
* Lead the planning and delivery of publicity activity in Spain, including talent tours, premieres, special screenings, awards campaigns, film festival participation and other cultural moments that enhance campaign visibility.
* Coordinate talent schedules, oversee tour and junket logistics, and manage supplier negotiations and onboarding processes, including purchase orders, vendor creation and contracts.
* Coordinate the Spanish publicity budget, monitor campaign performance against agreed objectives and KPIs, and provide clear status updates to senior stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong relationships across print, broadcast, online and influencer media, securing high\-quality editorial coverage and coordinating participation in local and international media opportunities.
* Support publicity strategies for local productions, oversee publicity materials and media monitoring activities, and coordinate the publicity team while supporting their development and ensuring delivery across multiple film titles.

**Qualifications \& Experience*** Extensive experience in publicity, communications or PR within an entertainment company, film studio, media organisation or specialised agency in a management level position.
* Excellent written and spoken English skills with the ability to draft, adapt and present clear communications for local and international stakeholders.
* Strong knowledge of the Spanish media landscape, including entertainment, film, lifestyle, online and influencer media.
* Proven ability to coordinate multiple projects and priorities simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
* Collaborative approach with experience working effectively with internal teams, external agencies, media partners and international offices.

**How We Get Things Done…**


This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding\-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

**Championing Inclusion at WBD**


Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

title: Nômade Temple Madrid - F&B Director
description:
**About Nômade Temple Madrid**


Nômade Temple Madrid is more than a space, it is a vibrant hub where community, creativity, and conscious living meet in the heart of the city. Inspired by the bohemian and soulful essence of the Nômade universe, we bring together gastronomy, culture, wellness, and lifestyle to create meaningful and elevated experiences.

**Your role**


As **F\&B Director**, you will be responsible for leading the overall Food \& Beverage strategy and operation at Nômade Temple Madrid, overseeing our restaurants, bars, events, and F\&B experiences while ensuring that each outlet reflects the Nômade philosophy and achieves the highest standards of guest experience, operational excellence, team engagement, and financial performance. Working closely with the General Manager and the leadership team, you will drive the commercial and operational performance of the department, identify new opportunities, develop innovative concepts, optimize revenue and profitability, and lead a high\-performing team that delivers authentic, memorable, and distinctive hospitality experiences.

**What you will do**

* Define and lead the overall Food \& Beverage strategy for Nômade Temple Madrid, aligned with the brand vision and business objectives.
* Oversee the daily operation and performance of all F\&B outlets, ensuring consistency in service, quality, presentation, and guest experience.
* Develop and implement annual F\&B budgets, business plans, revenue strategies, and operational objectives.
* Drive profitability through effective management of revenue, food cost, beverage cost, labor cost, productivity, and operational expenses.
* Monitor key F\&B performance indicators and develop action plans to maximize revenue and profitability.
* Lead the development and continuous evolution of our restaurant, bar, rooftop, event, and other F\&B concepts.
* Ensure that each outlet has a clear identity while maintaining a consistent Nômade approach to hospitality.
* Collaborate closely with the Executive Chef and culinary leadership to develop menus, concepts, pricing strategies, and gastronomic experiences.
* Work together with Marketing, Events, Wellness, Sales, and Operations teams to create innovative experiences and activations that connect with our guests and community.
* Build strong relationships with suppliers, partners, producers, and external collaborators.
* Lead recruitment, onboarding, training, development, and succession planning across the F\&B department.
* Inspire and develop F\&B leaders, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, creativity, and continuous improvement.
* Establish and maintain service standards, operational procedures, and quality benchmarks across all F\&B areas.
* Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, health \& safety, licensing, and company standards.
* Analyze guest feedback, market trends, and industry developments to continuously improve the F\&B offering.
* Identify new commercial opportunities and partnerships that can increase revenue and strengthen the positioning of Nômade Temple Madrid.
* Represent the F\&B department within the hotel's leadership team and act as an ambassador of the Nômade brand.
* Contribute to the long\-term positioning and growth of Nômade Temple Madrid as a distinctive hospitality and lifestyle destination in Madrid.

**Who we’re looking for**

* An inspiring and commercially minded F\&B leader with a genuine passion for hospitality, gastronomy, and guest experience.
* A strategic thinker who can translate a brand vision into successful and profitable F\&B operations.
* A natural leader capable of inspiring, developing, and empowering diverse teams.
* Strong business acumen and a clear understanding of F\&B financial performance.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* A creative and entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and turn ideas into experiences.
* Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to maintain a clear strategic perspective.
* A hands\-on leader who understands that exceptional hospitality is created through both people and operational excellence.
* Adaptable, resilient, and comfortable working in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment.

**Requirements**

* Extensive experience in a senior Food \& Beverage leadership position, preferably as F\&B Director, F\&B Manager, or equivalent within luxury hotels, lifestyle hospitality, high\-end restaurants, or multi\-outlet operations.
* Proven experience managing multiple F\&B outlets and complex hospitality operations.
* Strong knowledge of F\&B financial management, budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and revenue optimization.
* Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing F\&B concepts and commercial strategies.
* Proven track record of leading, developing, and retaining high\-performing teams.
* Strong understanding of luxury hospitality service standards and guest experience.
* Knowledge of food safety, hygiene, health \& safety, and relevant regulatory requirements.
* Excellent organizational and problem\-solving skills.
* Fluency in Spanish and English.
* Additional languages are a plus.
* Valid EU / Spain work permit.

**Why join us?**


Because at Nômade, hospitality is not just operations, it is emotion, precision, and experience. You will be part of a vibrant environment where people, culture, and creativity come together to create unforgettable moments.

***Equal Opportunity Commitment***

*At Nômade Temple, we are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and respectful environment for all. We ensure equal opportunities in our recruitment process and guarantee fair treatment regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. All hiring decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and alignment with our values.*

title: Associate Director, Real Estate Investment Banking
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Associate / Associate Director SCS
  
  

The Role
  
  

We are seeking an Associate/Associate Director to join our EMEA Strategic Capital Solutions team based in London, Madrid or Frankfurt. The team combines our Real Estate Investment Banking and Pan European Capital Markets Sector teams as an integrated, market\-leading platform.
  
We specialise in complex, multi\-stakeholder transactions including large portfolio sales, corporate M\&A, recapitalisations, joint ventures, new funds and structured equity transactions. The team operates from offices in London, Madrid, and Frankfurt, within a highly motivated, high\-performing, investment\-banking\-style environment that values initiative, analytical rigor, and ambition.
  
As Associate/Associate Director, you'll be a trusted member of the team supporting directors throughout the full life cycle of projects. You will play an active role in live client processes, participating in client meetings and maintaining relationships. You'll also mentor analysts, graduates and junior team members, helping develop their financial analysis skills and understanding of the real estate market.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

**Execution Leadership:** Ensure quality and timeliness of all client\-facing materials and transaction documentation while coordinating multiple workstreams, anticipating execution obstacles, and demonstrating ownership of transaction outcomes.
  
  

**Transaction Management:** Manage complex transactions including joint ventures, corporate M\&A, portfolio and asset sales, maintaining clear communication between multiple stakeholders while managing competing priorities across simultaneous transactions.
  
  

**Sector Specialisation Development:** Build depth of market intelligence within preferred asset classes or product types, producing high\-quality sector/product\-specific technical analyses
  
  

**Client\-Facing Capability:** Present marketing materials and transaction updates with professionalism, respond effectively to technical client questions, and serve as point of contact externally.
  
  

**Financial Modelling and Analysis:** Create and interpret financial models for large portfolio sales, corporate M\&A, joint ventures, and structured equity transactions, providing strategic advice based on financial analysis and market trends with efficient turnaround times.
  
  

**Pitch Preparation and Business Development:** Support preparation and coordination of pitches for potential projects, develop creative business opportunities, and execute investor marketing strategies to grow the team pipeline.
  
  

**Cross\-functional Collaboration:** Develop connections with local teams to support investment processes, manage research team outputs, coordinate with marketing teams, and build relationships with internal specialist teams including sustainability.
  
  

**Team Leadership and Development:** Effectively supervise analyst team members on assigned deals, mentor graduates and junior team members on financial analysis and appraisal outputs, and support their professional development.
  
  

What Are We Looking For?
  
Minimum 3 years of demonstrated experience in investment banking / corporate finance with exposure to real estate, or real estate capital markets
  
Sustained excellence across execution responsibilities over 3\+ years
  
Strong financial modeling capabilities \- comfortable building and critically analyzing financial and valuation models and working with complex operating data
  
Sound understanding of financial statements and how operational metrics drive platform / property value
  
Deep market knowledge including submarkets, rental trends, and recent transactions
  
Consistent leadership on transactions
  
Excellent project management and organisational abilities with proven ability to manage multiple workstreams
  
Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills with ability to manage multiple stakeholders
  
Proven track record in independent client relationship management and business development
  
Deep market knowledge including submarkets, rental trends, and recent transactions
  
Meticulous attention to detail
  
Proactive attitude and ability to work independently while contributing to team objectives

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Mandarin Oriental Punta Negra, Mallorca is looking for a **Social Media Manager** to join our **Sales \& Marketing Team.**


Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional.


Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group is the award\-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought\-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting\-edge of luxury experiences.


Set against the stunning backdrop of Puerto Portals, Mandarin Oriental Punta Negra pulses with the vibrant spirit of Mallorca. Here, subtle and emotional luxury seamlessly blend with the island’s natural beauty and energy, offering a place where inspiration flows effortlessly. Celebrate the essence of Mallorca through bespoke experiences, dynamic culinary journeys, and rejuvenating wellness \- each designed to immerse you in the island’s vibrant atmosphere and extraordinary offerings.


**About the job**


Based at Mandarin Oriental Punta Negra, Mallorca, as the Social Media Manager, you will be responsible for developing and implementing social media strategies in order to increase online presence and improve marketing and sales efforts of the resort and its outlets. This position works closely with different departments to develop and execute the story telling at the resort.


**As Social Media Manager, you will be responsible for the following duties:**


* With the guidance of the Director of Marketing Communications, design and implement the hotel’s social media and e\-commerce strategy with KPIs.
* Proactively plan creative, compelling, and targeted social media activity and campaigns.
* Stay informed of upcoming trends and developments within the field of social media.
* Research and develop new ways to leverage social content to improve performance.
* Setting KPIs for social media agencies and using relevant social media monitoring tools to manage all the resort’s social channels.
* Conduct competitive analysis of studies on competition and provide recommendations on content changes for the resort’s social channels.
* Oversee and manage all social media accounts for the resort, including each F\&B outlet, while leading community management strategies and daily engagement for every account.
* Prepare and implement the annual social media content strategy in accordance to brand.
* Plan and execute social media influencer campaigns, working closely with local and/or international influencers / KOLs and with the Public Relations agency.
* Collaborate create and execute social media campaigns that will generate leads, drive quality traffic and fans/follower’s engagement.
* Prepare monthly reports on social media for distribution to department heads and executive committee.
* Work closely with various departments to produce quality content for social media.
* Writing, commissioning, and editing materials for a range of key hotel audiences for use across all social media platforms.
* Plan, organize and oversee all social media photography / videography sessions.
**As Social Media Manager, we expect from you:**


Experience and education


* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, eCommerce Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of 2 years of solid experience in a similar role, preferably within the luxury hospitality sector (resort experience is considered a plus).
Technical Skills


* Excellent communication skills with an articulate and compelling communication style.
* Strong writing ability, capable of adapting tone and style to different audiences and communication platforms.
* Proven project management skills with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
* Creative mindset with the ability to think innovatively and work with flair and imagination.
* Strong communication skills in English and Spanish, both written and spoken.
**Our commitment to you**


* Learning \& Development. Your success is our success. We craft unique learning and development programmes for various stages in your career so that you grow, continuously.
* MOstay. When you work as hard as our colleagues do, it’s important to take time off. As a member of the \#MOfamily, you can stay with us wherever you go in the world. The MOstay programme offers complimentary nights and additionally attractive rates on rooms for you and your loved ones.
* Health \& Colleague Wellness. Finding the right work\-life balance is important. Your wellbeing matters to us. A variety of health benefits and wellness programmes are offered to all our colleagues, globally.
**We’re Fans. Are you?**

Part of the Wolters Kluwer’s CP \& ESG division, our award\-winning CCH® Tagetik expert solution provides the strategic \& financial intelligence platform that enables CFOs and their peers, in global enterprises, to propel their strategy with faster and better\-informed decisions. CCH Tagetik provides a comprehensive, data\-driven, AI\-based CPM platform for Financial Close \& Consolidation, Extended Planning including financial \& operational planning, ESG and Regulatory reporting, and Corporate Tax including Global Minimum Tax. With embedded AI and state\-of\-the\-art governance, the open and extensible platform easily connects leading operational solutions to create enterprise\-wide insights, drive growth, and navigate change for our customers to gain the greatest value, today and tomorrow.

**Role Summary**
----------------


The **Director, SaaS Migration Program Execution**, will be responsible for overseeing the entire migration process for **Wolters Kluwer CCH Tagetik’s existing customer base**. This position will own the transition from legacy deployment and commercial models to the strategic cloud platform and the latest packaging and pricing models. Responsibilities include:

* Managing the migration of commercial models for cloud customers who are still using legacy models.
* Leading both the commercial and technical migration for on\-premise customers.


This role is accountable for converting migration strategy into operational execution, coordinating cross\-functional teams across Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Cloud Operations, Legal, Finance and Product.


The position requires a highly hands\-on leader capable of driving customer migrations at scale while managing complex customer\-specific situations, particularly within the on\-premise installed base where commercial, contractual, technical and organizational complexity is highest.


The role serves as the central point of accountability for migration outcomes, capacity planning, execution governance, risk management, and business value realization.

**Key responsibilities:**

**Migration portfolio management**

* Own the global SaaS migration portfolio, maintaining a consolidated view of all migration opportunities across customer cohorts and geographies.
* Translate migration strategy into executable annual and quarterly migration plans, customer migration waves and measurable business outcomes.
* Own customer prioritization, migration sequencing and cohort governance, continuously reassessing customer readiness, migration complexity and commercial opportunity throughout the migration lifecycle.
* Recalibrate migration priorities and customer cohorts based on new customer information, migration outcomes and changing business priorities.

**Migration program leadership**

* Lead execution of the global SaaS migration roadmap across all migration cohorts and regions.
* Establish and operate the Migration Execution Office as the central coordination function across Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Consulting Partners, Cloud Operations, Finance, Legal and Product.
* Orchestrate end\-to\-end execution across all participating functions, ensuring effective planning, dependency management, handovers and accountability throughout the migration process.
* Ensure migration execution remains aligned with strategic objectives, customer commitments, available capacity and financial targets.
* Drive consistent execution through standardized migration methodologies, operational playbooks, templates and governance processes.

**Migration governance \& performance management**

* Establish and facilitate the governance structure supporting the migration program including executive decision forums, operational reviews and performance reporting.
* Define, monitor and continuously improve migration KPIs, dashboards and reporting to provide transparency on migration progress, customer status, commercial outcomes, delivery performance and business case realization.
* Identify systemic bottlenecks, operational risks and recurring execution challenges, driving corrective actions across the organization.
* Own migration exception management, ensuring customer, commercial, contractual, technical and operational escalations are resolved efficiently and consistently.
* Ensure adherence to commercial guardrails, approval processes, pricing governance and migration policies.

**Capacity planning \& execution readiness**

* Define migration capacity requirements across Professional Services, Consulting Partners, Cloud Operations and supporting functions, balancing migration demand with available delivery resources.
* Ensure migration readiness across all participating functions prior to each migration wave, including resource availability, governance, customer preparation and operational planning.
* Provide executive recommendations on resource allocation, outsourcing opportunities, partner utilization and execution scalability.

**Customer migration execution**

**On\-premise customer migration (technical \& commercial)**

* Oversee end\-to\-end execution of commercial and technical migrations from customer qualification through technical assessment, commercial design, implementation, testing, product transition and post\-go\-live optimization.
* Coordinate cross\-functional delivery teams throughout the migration lifecycle while proactively resolving delivery risks and execution blockers.

**Cloud customer migration (commercial)**

* Lead the commercial migration program for existing cloud customers transitioning to the new packaging and pricing model.

* Balance customer retention, migration velocity, commercial standardization and ARR realization while ensuring compliance with commercial governance and negotiation guardrails.

**Continuous improvement**

* Capture lessons learned from completed migration waves and incorporate them into future migration planning, execution standards and governance processes.
* Continuously improve migration methodologies, planning assumptions, operational playbooks, reporting and customer engagement models.
* Drive increased standardization and scalability of migration execution while maintaining flexibility for strategic customer situations.
* Identify opportunities to automate, simplify and optimize migration processes across commercial and technical functions.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Minimum Bachelor’s in Engineering, Information Technology, Business or related field.
* 10\+ years of experience leading large\-scale transformation, cloud migration, SaaS transition or customer lifecycle programs.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex enterprise customer implementations and migrations.
* Strong program management, stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams in a matrix organization.

title: IT Business Analyst - LIMS Process Expert
description:
**Company Description** ***Why are we here?***


Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.


Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

 **Job Description** **In a nutshell**


As a **Business Analyst, expert in LIMS Processes,** you will support our in‑house chromatography data processing application. You will translate laboratory and business requirements into clear deliverables, optimize analytical workflows for quality and efficiency, and ensure compliance with major EU environmental testing laboratory standards.


You’ will partner with laboratory leaders, product and engineering teams, finance, and commercial stakeholders to standardize processes and guide delivery of features that streamline instrument data capture, processing, quality control (QC), technical review, and reporting across hyphenated and non\-hyphenated analytical workflows (gas chromatography GC, liquid chromatography LC, inductively coupled plasma ICP and mass spectrometry (MS).

**Where will you be based and what business will you support?**


Based in Madrid, Spain; you will join a globally distributed team in support of our European Environmental Testing business, with a primary focus on chromatography data processing application.

**How can you help us?**


You will work on the following main areas:

**Strategy \& Operational Analysis, to:**

* Assess the EU Environmental Testing market, regulatory expectations, and laboratory operational data to identify opportunities for efficiency, quality improvement, and margin enhancement.
* Support EU‑focused pricing, client segmentation, and demand modeling to guide product and investment priorities.
* Recommend improvements to enhance turnaround time (TAT), analytical quality, data reliability, and regulatory alignment.

**Product / Requirements Ownership (Chromatography Data System Software), to:**

* Serve as primary liaison between EU laboratory stakeholders and the Product Development team.
* Elicit, document, and refine Business Requirements, User Requirements, and acceptance criteria (including non‑functional needs like performance and usability).
* Maintain and update process documentation, including BRD (Business Requirements Document), URD (User Requirements Document), and BPMN (Business Process Model \& Notation).
* Collaborate with Product Development team to translate requirements into functional designs; help groom backlogs and support release scoping.
* Lead EU‑regional user acceptance testing (UAT), business sign‑off, and change management for new features and workflow updates.

**Cross‑Functional Business Support, to:**

* Partner with laboratory directors, technical leads, and product teams across the EU to harmonize chromatography data workflows.
* Facilitate workshops with subject matter experts (SMEs) to challenge assumptions, streamline workflows, and improve cross‑site alignment.
* Build and maintain strong relationships across operations, R\&D, quality, IT, and commercial units.

**Process Optimization \& Quality Alignment, to:**

* Map current vs. future‑state EU laboratory workflows; identify gaps, risks, and compliance needs.
* Ensure alignment with Eurofins Quality System Documents (SOPs, methods, work instructions).
* Ensure processes, requirements, and software workflows comply with key EU laboratory frameworks, including: ISO/IEC 17025, EU Ecolabel testing requirements, and EU Member State national accreditation bodies operating under EA (European co‑operation for Accreditation)
* Support audit preparation, nonconformity resolution, CAPAs, and continuous improvement.
* Track corrective actions and measure system/process impact post‑deployment.

**Data, Reporting \& Financial Insight, to:**

* Build dashboards (performance, throughput, error rates, QC metrics, method performance, adoption/usage).
* Support budgeting, forecasting, and operational reviews with EU‑specific actionable insights.
* Validate product requirements with data, quantify product value, and measure outcomes.

  

**Qualifications** **Are you our kind of extraordinary?**

**You have:**

* A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Science, Engineering, IT, or related field.
* 3\+ years as a Business Analyst or Product Owner/Analyst in software, laboratory operations, or scientific environments.
* Experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional documentation in an Agile environment (e.g., Jira/Confluence).
* Familiarity with laboratory informatics such as LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) and CDS (Chromatography Data System).
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills across multi‑cultural EU teams.
* Working knowledge of EU environmental testing compliance frameworks, including but not limited to: ISO/IEC 17025, EU Ecolabel requirements, and European Accreditation (EA)
* Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills
* Strong analytical skills; proficiency in Excel (SQL/BI tools a plus).

**You are:**

* A strong communicator in English (written/oral).
* A fast learner.
* Self\-motivated with a can\-do attitude.

**What else should I know?**

**The following skills are an advantage:**

* Experience in environmental (chromatography workflows is a plus), food, agroscience or biopharma testing and laboratory operations in EU‑regulated scientific environments.
* Experience building BPMN workflows and writing functional specifications.
* Exposure to LIMS, CDS, or scientific data management platforms; understanding of instrument integration.
* MBA, M.Sc., or advanced scientific/technical degree.

  

**Additional Information** **We support your development!** Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

**We embrace diversity!** Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

**Sustainability matters to us!** We are well on our way to achieving our objective of carbon neutrality by 2025, through a combination of emission reduction and compensation initiatives. We encourage our laboratory leaders to make sustainable changes at their local level, and in addition to their initiatives we also count on our dedicated carbon reduction team to help us to achieve this goal!

**Find out more in our career page: https://careers.eurofins.com/**

**Company description:** Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.


The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.


In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of over 950 laboratories in 60 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.


In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6,95 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

Morningstar DBRS is seeking a **Manager, Data Quality \& Controls** to lead the development and execution of the enterprise data quality and controls program. Reporting to the Senior Director, Data Products, this role will assess existing controls, identify gaps, and establish standards, processes, and governance to ensure critical ratings, regulatory, and enterprise data is accurate, complete, well\-documented, and fit for purpose.


The Manager will drive the data controls roadmap, design scalable quality controls, and partner across Data Management, Credit Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk, Compliance, and Product teams to embed strong data practices into operations, regulatory reporting, platform modernization, and AI initiatives.


The ideal candidate has experience building or enhancing data governance and control frameworks within a regulated financial services environment and can influence stakeholders across all levels of the organization.


**Key Responsibilities:**

**Data Controls \& Governance**

Lead the design and ongoing enhancement of the enterprise data controls framework, including governance standards, workflows, metrics, issue management, and remediation processes. Assess existing controls, identify gaps, and drive improvements that align with regulatory requirements, audit expectations, and industry best practices. Own the data controls roadmap and promote data stewardship, accountability, and ownership across the organization.


**Standards, Procedures \& Data Quality**

Develop and maintain data governance standards, procedures, and controls related to data quality, metadata, lineage, documentation, classification, retention, and issue management. Therefore, while **we are managing the recruitment and selection process, the successful candidate will join Zurich Duo directly and the position will be within the Zurich Duo team**.

**What is Zurich Duo?**
-----------------------

**Zurich Duo is Zurich’s in\-house agency**, responsible for conceptualizing, designing, and delivering creative, digital marketing, and customer experience projects across international markets.


Operating like a startup within a major global corporation, Zurich Duo combines an **agile, dynamic, and entrepreneurial environment** with the resources, expertise, and stability of a leading global company.


It brings together the **best of both worlds**: the energy and flexibility of a young, fast\-moving company, with the scale, support, and opportunities of an established industry leader.

**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for a **Creative Specialist** who excels at turning strategic direction into compelling social media content ideas and high\-quality, executable assets.


In this role, you will bring **Duo’s creative strategy to life** across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, Reddit, and emerging social channels. You will be responsible for developing **platform\-native content from concept through execution**, adapting messages, formats, and storytelling to the specific characteristics of each channel while ensuring that every piece remains aligned with the original creative vision and brand voice.

**What will your mission be?**
------------------------------


To translate creative strategies and briefs into **platform\-native content**, developing storyboards, post concepts, and visual proposals that are engaging, execution\-ready, and aligned with each channel’s best practices.

**Responsibilities \& Key Tasks**
---------------------------------

* **Brief Translation**: Transform Creative Strategist briefs into detailed creative ideas and platform\-ready content executions.
* **Content Ideation \& Scripting**: Develop storyboards, scripts, post concepts, captions, and visual directions.
* **Asset Creation \& Adaptation**: Create, adapt, and optimize social media assets tailored specifically to TikTok, Instagram, Reddit, and other channels
* **Editorial Proposals**: Build content proposals for editorial calendars based on defined content territories and strategic briefs.
* **Video Collaboration**: Work closely with Videomakers to shape and produce high\-impact short\-form video executions.
* **Platform Native Adaptation**: Adapt content seamlessly to each platform's unique codes, formats, audience behaviors, and emerging trends.
* **Quality \& Brand Consistency**: Ensure final assets are consistent with the original creative idea, brand voice, visual tone, and specific channel requirements.

**Requirements \& Key Skills**
------------------------------

* **Experience: 3–4 years** of experience creating content for brands, social media, or creative agencies.
* **Content Mastery**: Strong understanding of platform\-native formats, particularly short\-form video, with a sharp eye for design, visual rhythm, hooks, and social trends.
* **Concept\-to\-Execution**: Proven ability to take a project seamlessly from initial idea to storyboard and final execution asset.
* **Copywriting \& Storytelling**: Excellent copywriting, caption\-writing, and visual storytelling skills.
* **Technical Tools**: Hands\-on experience with creation and editing tools such as CapCut, Canva, adobe Creative Suite, or similar.
* **Multidisciplinary Collaboration**: Ability to collaborate smoothly with Strategists, Insights teams, Videomakers, Designers, and Project Managers.
* **Mindset \& Languages**: Highly organized, proactive, and execution\-oriented, with a high level of English suitable for an international work environment.

**What we value**

* **Background in social media agencies or digital content creation.**
* **Exceptional creative sensibility and visual taste.**
* **Strong track record in creating native short\-form video content.**

To ensure clear alignment on responsibilities, the following tasks fall outside the scope of this position:

Hyatt is looking for an Associate Manager, CRM , Digital Campaigns \& Projects to join the Digital \& Direct Channel team in Palma de Mallorca, Spain, working under a hybrid model.


In this role, you will contribute to the growth of Hyatt’s direct channels through the planning, execution, and optimization of CRM and digital campaigns, as well as the coordination of projects related to the digital and web experience. You will work with regional and global teams, hotels, agencies, and external partners to drive customer and World of Hyatt member acquisition, conversion, engagement, loyalty, and retention.

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and in creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and guests have been at the heart of our business and have helped Hyatt become one of the world’s leading and fastest\-growing hospitality companies.


Our purpose is to care for people so they can be their best. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers.

Reporting to the Director, Digital \& Direct Channels South EAME, the **Associate Manager, CRM , Digital Campaigns \& Projects** will be responsible for coordinating the strategy, execution, and optimization of CRM initiatives, digital campaigns, and projects related to the web and digital ecosystem.

  

**Key responsibilities include:**

  

* Coordinate campaigns, tactics, and touchpoints aimed at Hyatt guests and World of Hyatt members, using segmentation, personalization, and data analysis to improve engagement, conversion, and direct bookings.
* Manage the relationship calendar and ensure the proper alignment of campaigns with commercial, regional, global, and hotel priorities.
* Lead the execution and optimization of CRM and digital campaigns, ensuring alignment with direct\-channel performance objectives.
* Coordinate promotions and activations across the digital ecosystem, managing timelines, content, assets, and messaging across different touchpoints.
* Act as a liaison between Digital Marketing, Web, Contact Center, Revenue Management, Operations, eDistribution, and Marketing teams.
* Coordinate digital projects from end to end, managing milestones, dependencies, risks, deliverables, and stakeholder communication.
* Monitor performance, define and track CRM KPIs, and prepare reports with actionable insights and recommendations.
* Analyze customer behavior and feedback to continuously improve CRM initiatives and the digital customer experience.
* Ensure CRM processes comply with GDPR and best practices in data governance and data quality.
* Coordinate relationships with CRM and digital agencies across South EAME and the wider EAME region, ensuring consistency in strategy, reporting, execution, and best\-practice adoption.

**Who You Are**

  

You are passionate about improving the customer experience through data, technology, and creativity. You are organized, collaborative, and results\-oriented, with the ability to coordinate complex projects and connect teams with different perspectives.


You also share Hyatt’s core values of empathy, inclusion, integrity, experimentation, respect, and wellbeing.

description:

---------------


We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world\-class generics business. Here, you will be part of a high\-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.**Our Team, Your Impact**
-------------------------



We are looking for an Associate Director, Capability Building \& Change Management to own and drive communication, change management, internal branding, asset creation, and capability\-building activities as part of Global Procurement Transformation. This role will shape how teams understand transformation priorities, adopt new tools and ways of working, engage with AI\-enabled and technology\-driven change, and build the capabilities needed in a more digital, data\-driven, and agile procurement environment.


The successful candidate will work closely with procurement leaders, subject matter experts, digital teams, global L\&D, technology partners, and external providers to lead clear communication, practical change adoption, targeted learning enablement, and compelling transformation storytelling. The role will bring structure, pace, and ownership to change activities, connect the right experts, align priorities, create reusable communication and enablement assets, and ensure Global Procurement Transformation changes are understood, supported, branded consistently, and embedded over time.

**Location**
------------



Croatia, Spain or the Netherlands

**How You’ll Spend Your Day**
-----------------------------


* **Own communication and stakeholder engagement for Global Procurement Transformation**
* Develop clear, audience\-relevant communication plans for Global Procurement Transformation priorities, initiatives, and activities.
* Translate complex business, process, and technology topics into simple messages that explain what is changing, why it matters, what support is available, and what actions are expected.
* Equip leaders and managers with messaging, materials, engagement moments, and communication assets that build understanding, confidence, and alignment.
* Develop communication assets, internal branding materials, launch narratives, leadership messages, FAQs, toolkits, and adoption content that create a consistent identity for procurement transformation and make change easier to understand and engage with.
* **Drive change management and adoption of new ways of working**
* Lead change readiness, stakeholder impact assessment, adoption planning, and reinforcement for procurement tools, processes, digital solutions, and AI\-enabled use cases where relevant.
* Support deployment of new procurement technologies and tools by shaping launch plans, adoption campaigns, readiness materials, and reinforcement activities that help users move from awareness to confident usage.
* Bring AI transformation into the change agenda by helping teams understand AI\-enabled use cases, responsible adoption expectations, capability needs, and practical examples of how AI can improve procurement work.
* Proactively identify adoption barriers, resistance, confusion, or capability gaps, and drive practical actions to address them.
* Partner with transformation, digital, process, and procurement teams to embed new ways of working into day\-to\-day routines and sustain momentum.
* Drive reinforcement activities that encourage sustained usage, behavior change, and measurable adoption over time.
* **Support procurement capability building and learning enablement**
* Build and maintain a practical procurement capability roadmap aligned with Global Procurement Transformation priorities, business needs, and future skills requirements.
* Help identify priority capability gaps across technical, digital, data, communication, change, and soft skills.
* Partner with procurement subject matter experts and global L\&D to translate specialist knowledge into practical learning, playbooks, communication assets, and adoption materials.
* Create practical enablement assets such as playbooks, one\-pagers, launch packs, quick reference guides, demo scripts, user communications, and adoption toolkits for new tools, AI\-enabled solutions, and transformation initiatives.
* Coordinate learning and enablement activities that build confidence, strengthen adoption, and improve team effectiveness.
* **Track progress and drive continuous improvement**
* Track simple, meaningful indicators for learning participation, adoption, capability uplift, and business impact where measurable.
* Use feedback, usage data, and stakeholder input to continuously improve learning content, adoption support, and the overall user experience.
* Partner with global L\&D operations to manage learning logistics, platform activities, and reporting with clear ownership and follow\-through.
**Your Skills and Experience**
------------------------------


* Master’s degree preferred; relevant certification in change management, learning and development, project/program management, or procurement is an advantage.
* 7\+ years of relevant experience in Procurement in a global corporate environment; experience with AI Transformations, supporting program communications, change management, procurement transformation, learning enablement, or functional capability programs is highly preferred
* Ability to create clear communication plans and support change readiness, impact assessment, adoption planning, reinforcement, and measurement for new ways of working.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to translate complex topics into clear, audience\-relevant messages.
* Comfort working with digital tools, AI\-enabled technologies, data, Microsoft Office applications, collaboration platforms, learning technologies, and communication asset creation tools.
**Also Good to Have**
---------------------


* Experience in program communications, change management, stakeholder engagement, capability building, or learning enablement within a global corporate or functional environment.
* Practical understanding of communication and change management activities, including readiness, stakeholder engagement, training, adoption, reinforcement, and measurement.
* Strong communication, storytelling, stakeholder engagement, and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and tailor messages for different audiences.
* A practical, delivery\-oriented mindset, with the ability to coordinate cross\-functional initiatives, manage change activities, and turn plans into clear actions.
* Comfort working with digital tools, AI\-enabled solutions, data\-driven ways of working, and technology\-enabled business transformation, including the ability to translate technology change into practical user adoption support.
* Ability to create engaging transformation assets and internal branding materials that make complex programs feel coherent, accessible, and easy to adopt across a global audience.
* Procurement, learning academy, digital adoption, change network, or learning platform experience would be an advantage.
**How We’ll Take Care of You**
------------------------------


At Teva, better health starts from within, and that includes you. From day one, you’ll be supported with benefits designed to help you thrive in and out of work. This includes generous annual leave, reward plans, flexible working schedules (dependent on role), access to tailored health support, and meaningful ways to give back to the community. When it comes to your career, you’ll be encouraged to explore, evolve, and shape your path. Twist, our one\-stop shop for career development platform, gives you access to a wide range of possibilities, from learning programs and short\-term projects to opportunities for internal growth. Here, you’ll be part of a culture that empowers you to reach your goals and prioritize your wellbeing every step of the way.**Already Working @Teva?**

Make sure to apply through our internal career site on Twist—your one\-stop shop for career development**Teva’s Equal Employment Opportunity Commitment**

It is Teva's global policy that equal employment opportunity be provided without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, disability, pregnancy, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, veteran status, national or ethnic origin or any other legally recognized status entitled to protection under applicable laws. You will work on the **Research Topic Management (RTM)** application — a distributed .NET system with Vue/Nuxt frontends, SQL Server\-heavy data operations, Github/Azure DevOps\-driven deployments, and async integration workflows connecting multiple internal services.


This is a senior role where **autonomy, ownership, and technical leadership** are central. You will own complex backend systems and full\-stack features end\-to\-end — from specification refinement and architectural decisions, through implementation, to production monitoring and incident resolution. You will work on real production systems where SQL performance, distributed reliability, and integration correctness matter daily.


We have fully embraced **AI\-based spec\-driven design**, integrating AI throughout the entire software development lifecycle — using skills, rules, multi\-agent workflows, and automation for code review, testing, and code analysis. From specification to implementation, AI tooling shapes how we architect, build, and iterate, making us faster, more deliberate, and focused on what matters most. This isn’t an experiment. It’s how we work.


Your work directly enables researchers worldwide to collaborate, publish openly, and push science forward.


Science advances fastest when researchers can collaborate across boundaries — institutional, geographic, and disciplinary. **Research Topics** are how Frontiers makes that happen.


Each Research Topic is a themed collection of peer\-reviewed articles built around an emerging or critical area of science. Leading researchers from around the world propose a theme, invite contributors, and curate the resulting work — transforming scattered individual efforts into a coherent, openly accessible body of knowledge. When complete, every collection is published as a free ebook, available to anyone, anywhere.


These are not just publications. They are communities of researchers working together toward answers that matter: healthier lives, a more sustainable planet, a deeper understanding of the world we share.


The **Research Topic Management (RTM)** application is the platform that makes this possible at scale. It supports the full lifecycle — from the moment a researcher proposes a topic, through editorial coordination, contributor recruitment, and submission tracking, all the way to publication and closure. RTM gives the teams behind Frontiers the tools they need to turn a scientific idea into open, lasting knowledge — one collection at a time.

### **Atolls is the world's largest community\-driven shopping platform, active in 20\+ markets.**



We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re\-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.



Our 1,000\+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.



### **About This Role:**



We're looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to take ownership of our **Gift Cards** vertical \- one of the fastest\-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross\-market growth across France, Germany, and Spain.



This is a high\-ownership, high\-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple\-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with \- and may grow into ownership of \- adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in\-store rewards portfolio.



We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand\-holding.



### **Our Benefits:**



At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:


* A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
* A supportive and open\-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
* 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.

* Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
* Mental health coaching to support your well\-being.
* Regular global and local get\-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
* The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
* A cloud\-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.


* *These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.*



### **Responsibilities:**



In this role, you will:


* **Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap** \- from provider selection and inventory quality to the end\-to\-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.
* **Lead commercial and provider negotiations** \- framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi\-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.

* **Use data to lead, not just report** \- build and refine models (e.g. fraud\-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest\-impact bet.
* **Represent the vertical at the leadership level** \- bring clear recommendations and trade\-offs to cross\-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.
* **Build for scale** \- help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

 ### **Your Profile:**



We're looking for someone with {explicit job content} experience, who is dedicated to creating exceptional user experiences and driving innovation.


* **5\+ years in product management**, including significant time owning a product or business line end\-to\-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup.

* **Commercial fluency \-** comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.

* **Proven cross\-functional leadership** \- experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.

**We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.**

 **Marketing Manager**

* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve complex, cross\-functional issues.

* Excellent English communication skills for global audience engagement.

* Experience across several marketing disciplines: content, social media, and community.

* Crisis communication experience.

* Base compensation of $3000/month plus annual bonus.
* Fully remote collaboration.
* High autonomy to explore, test, and improve marketing processes.
* Work alongside an experienced, global marketing team.

**Jurisdictions:** this is a single, flexible mandate that can be run across any of our key offshore and onshore markets – including the Channel Islands, Luxembourg, Ireland, the UK, Cayman, BVI, Bermuda, the Isle of Man and the Middle East.

Job Title: Social Media Marketing Executive/Coordinator

Company: Arabnb Vacation Homes Rental Co. LLC

Department: Marketing

Location: Dubai, UAE (On\-site)

Employment Type: Full\-Time

Reports To: Founder / Managing Director

**About Us**

**ARABNB Holiday Homes**

Arabnb is a luxury vacation homes company operating across Dubai. We manage AED 100M\+ in high\-value real estate assets, including premium apartments and villas in Dubai’s topperforming prime districts. Every Arabnb residence features elevated amenities — fully equipped kitchens, premium linens, fast WiFi, smart home comforts, private balconies, community pools, and dedicated workspaces. From concierge services to seamless property management, we redefine what luxury short\-stay living looks like in Dubai.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a creative, driven, and resourceful Social Media Marketing Executive to join us in\-house in Dubai. This person will take full ownership of the social media presence for both Arabnb Holiday Homes across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and LinkedIn. You will be the voice and visual identity of both brands online — planning, creating, filming, editing, and publishing content on a daily basis. You will also manage the Founder’s personal LinkedIn profile, building thought leadership in the hospitality and real estate space. Being based on\-site in Dubai is essential. The role requires frequent content filming at our vacation home properties, development sites, and around Dubai, as well as real\-time posting and close collaboration with the team. This is not a remote or hybrid position.

**Key Responsibilities**

Arabnb Holiday Homes — Vacation Homes \& Hospitality · Create and execute a social media content calendar for Arabnb across Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook, showcasing our luxury vacation home portfolio.

· Film and edit high\-quality property walkthrough videos, guest experience content, Reels, TikToks, and Stories that highlight the lifestyle and amenities of each Arabnb property.

· Develop content themes around Dubai tourism, luxury short\-stay living, guest testimonials, property reveals, and seasonal promotions.

· Write compelling captions and copy that speak to potential guests, property owners, and investors, tailored to each platform.

· Engage with the Arabnb community — respond to DMs, comments, and inquiries promptly to drive bookings and build brand loyalty.

· Build and execute a direct booking strategy to reduce reliance on OTAs (Airbnb, Booking.com, etc.) and drive guests to book directly through the Arabnb website.

· Set up and manage retargeting campaigns via Meta Business Suite to re\-engage previous guests and website visitors, encouraging repeat stays and direct bookings.

· Implement and manage basic SEO for the Arabnb website — optimise property listing pages, blog content, meta descriptions, and keywords to increase organic search visibility and drive traffic.

· Create and drive traffic to dedicated landing pages, seasonal offers, and promotional campaigns designed to convert website visitors into direct bookings.

· Develop and manage a customer loyalty program to incentivise repeat guests — including referral rewards, returning guest discounts, exclusive offers, and email\-based re\-engagement campaigns.

· Work on email marketing flows (welcome sequences, post\-stay follow\-ups, special offers) to nurture past guests and encourage direct re\-bookings.

· Track and report on Arabnb social media performance metrics (reach, engagement, follower growth, booking enquiries, website traffic, direct booking conversions) and provide actionable insights.

· Plan, set up, run, and optimise paid advertising campaigns through Meta Business Suite (Facebook \& Instagram Ads), including audience targeting, A/B testing, budget management, and performance reporting.

· Set up and manage TikTok Ads campaigns when required.

· Design graphics, carousels, thumbnails, and marketing creatives using Canva and other design tools for both brands.

· Monitor social media trends, competitor activity, and platform algorithm changes to keep both brands ahead of the curve.

· Coordinate and plan content shoots, including scheduling, location scouting, and directing talent on camera.

· Manage influencer outreach and coordinate collaborations relevant to either brand.

· Provide weekly/monthly performance reports with data\-driven recommendations.

**Requirements \& Qualifications**

· Experience: 1–2 years of hands\-on experience in social media marketing, content creation, or a similar digital marketing role. Experience in real estate, hospitality, or luxury lifestyle brands is a strong plus.

· Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory if experience is strong).

· Video Editing: Proficient in video editing software such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, InShot, or similar tools. Must be able to produce polished, professional video content independently — from filming to final edit.

· Design Skills: Strong working knowledge of Canva for creating social media graphics, Stories templates, presentation decks, and marketing collateral.

· Meta Business Suite: Hands\-on experience with Meta Business Suite is essential. Must know how to set up, run, and optimise paid ad campaigns on Facebook and Instagram, including audience targeting, custom audiences, lookalike audiences, retargeting, A/B testing, and budget management. Ability to read and act on ad performance data is a must.

· Platform Expertise: Deep understanding of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and LinkedIn — including best practices, algorithms, content formats, and native analytics tools.

· Copywriting: Excellent written English with the ability to craft engaging captions, CTAs, and copy for different audiences — from luxury hospitality guests to real estate investors and brokers.

· Creativity: A strong creative eye with the ability to conceptualise and execute original content ideas that drive engagement, build brand awareness, and generate leads.

· SEO \& Website Traffic: Basic to intermediate understanding of SEO principles — keyword research, on\-page optimisation, meta tags, and content strategy to drive organic traffic to the Arabnb website and increase direct bookings.

· Analytics: Comfortable using Meta Business Suite, TikTok Analytics, LinkedIn Analytics, Instagram Insights, and Google Analytics to measure performance, track website traffic, and inform strategy.

· Email Marketing: Familiarity with email marketing platforms (e.g., Mailchimp, Brevo) for building guest re\-engagement flows, loyalty campaigns, and promotional newsletters.

· Location: Must be based in Dubai, UAE and available to work on\-site full\-time. This is not a remote or hybrid position.

**Nice to Have**

· Experience running TikTok Ads campaigns.

· Experience with scheduling tools such as Later, Hootsuite, Buffer, or Metricool.

· Photography skills and comfort being on camera or directing others on camera.

· Familiarity with CRM tools or lead capture workflows.

· Experience in Dubai’s real estate or holiday home/hospitality industry.

· Experience with Google Ads or Google Hotel Ads for driving direct bookings.

· Familiarity with loyalty program tools or platforms (e.g., Stamp Me, LoyaltyLion).

· Understanding of OTA dynamics (Airbnb, Booking.com) and strategies to drive direct bookings away from third\-party platforms.

**What We Offer**

· Competitive monthly salary of AED 5,000 – 6,000 (based on experience and skills).

· Opportunity to take full ownership of the social media presence for two growing Dubai brands — in luxury hospitality.

· A dynamic, fast\-paced work environment with room for creativity, ownership, and career growth.

· Direct mentorship and collaboration with the Founder.

· Exposure to vacation rental industries in one of the world’s most exciting property markets.

· Visa sponsorship (if applicable).

· Annual leave and public holidays as per UAE Labour Law.

**How to Apply Interested candidates should submit the following:**

· Updated CV/Resume.

· Portfolio or links to social media accounts you have managed (especially in real estate, hospitality, or lifestyle sectors).

· Examples of paid ad campaigns you have run on Meta Business Suite, including results if available.

· A short cover letter explaining why you are the right fit for this role.

Pay: AED5,000\.00 \- AED6,000\.00 per month

title: Senior Officer, Health Partnerships, Global Corporate Partnerships
description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non\-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions\-driven, passionate change\-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world\-wide for a better future.

**Job Background/Overview:**


The International Rescue Committee (IRC) is seeking a driven partnerships professional with a wealth of knowledge and excitement for the health sector, who will develop and deepen partnerships with corporate partners in support of our mission to help refugees survive, recover and gain control of their future.


Since its inception in 1933, the IRC offers lifesaving care and life\-changing assistance to refugees forced to flee from war or disaster. This temporary role is part of the Global Corporate Partnerships (GCP) team, which leads on the IRC's engagement with corporations and corporate foundations across key global sectors such as financial services, healthcare, consumer goods and technology.


The ideal candidate is someone experienced and familiar with the Global Health sector, the major players, and the key partnerships and funding opportunities. Candidates with knowledge of the financial services sector, or broader experience working across corporate industries, are also encouraged to apply. As a Senior Officer with a dedicated portfolio of corporate partners — primarily in Global Health, with a smaller portfolio of financial services accounts — you will cultivate, steward, and solicit corporate donors and will build tailored fundraising strategies and activations, focusing on incremental and sustained revenue generation, in\-kind support, and humanitarian impact.


The Senior Officer will also demonstrate a passion for the IRC's mission, nuanced understanding of private sector fundraising, and dedication to the organization's diversity, equity, and inclusion values.

**Major Responsibilities:**

* Steward and cultivate a $3M\+ USD portfolio of partners and new business prospects in support of the Global Corporate Partnerships Health strategy with a focus on diversified funding streams, growing flexible funds, and expanding influence.
* Help to deliver a robust strategy for the Global Health sector; identifying and initiating strategies for sector partnerships through a variety of partnership models (e.g. Strategic, employee engagement, pro bono expertise, etc.).
* Support the Associate Director of Health Partnerships in proactively building and managing a robust new business pipeline, researching and identifying prospective corporate partners in the Global Health sector (and financial services, where relevant) to drive incremental revenue growth.
* Design and implement creative stewardship, engagement and growth strategies for partners within the portfolio including account plans, proposal submissions and partnership discussions.
* Develop and review materials for partners or prospects, including proposed partnership overviews and activation ideas, concept notes, proposals, presentations, and reports.
* Work closely with the External Relations teams (e.g., digital, creative studio, experiential events) to leverage health\-related virtual and in\-person events and campaigns to support the overall fundraising efforts of the organization.
* Establish a robust client servicing plan for each portfolio partner, including identifying key performance indicators, ongoing planning and reporting procedures to optimize quality of service, income growth, and donor satisfaction.
* Facilitate information flows between prospects and donors, program staff and fellow GCP officers;
* Undertake special assignments, as needed.

**Essential Qualifications:**

**Work Experience:**

* Bachelor’s Degree, or equivalent 6 years relevant experience;
* Experience working within the Global Health sector and community;
* Minimum 6 years’ experience of partnership development and/or front\-line corporate fundraising experience in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment;
* Experience identifying and exploring new and creative ways of engaging with health companies and their communities, influencers, and other partners to support humanitarian efforts.

**Demonstrated Skills and Competencies:**

* Management or solicitation of partnerships valued at or above $500,000 USD per year;
* Ability to develop thoughtful project management plans and implement them in timely and detailed fashion;
* Ability to accurately and efficiently in a fast\-paced environment and adapt to shifting priorities;
* Excellent interpersonal skills and written and oral communication skills: the ability to effectively interact with a variety of internal and external contacts with confidence and poise.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Strong project management skills, experience working on multiple projects with global cross\-functional teams;
* Ability to travel for partnership meetings in the United States (twice per year) and potentially internationally for conferences, meetings, etc.

**Working Environment:** This role may require working remotely full\- or part\-time (i.e., telecommuting). Applicants must have a home or alternate workspace they can effectively complete their work from during regularly scheduled hours.

***This is a hybrid position open to internal candidates based in countries where IRC operates who have the right to work in their location. Successful candidates will be hired on a local employment contract and according to local salary scale.***

***This role is open to candidates located and with the right to work in United States of America, United Kingdom, and Kenya.***

**Compensation:** (US Pay Rate: $95,000\-$103,000/yr; UK Pay Rate: £52,210\-£61,999/yr). Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements.

 **Professional Standards:** All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way \- Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.
