description:
**About Ramp**
 Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000\+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
   

  

 The problems are high\-stakes, data\-dense, and unforgiving.
   

  

 We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
   

  

 The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
   

  

 If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Design at Ramp looks very different than it did a year ago: we’re building tools and agents, designing memory, shipping PRs, and rethinking the process every few months as new capabilities unlock. A few things have not changed, the role of design is to distill problems to their essence, obsess over craft and delight where it matters most, know customers deeply and advocate for them, lead with creativity and storytelling, and keep it fun, because a product built with joy always wins.
   

  

 We're looking for a Director of Product Design to lead a team of builders across some of our highest\-priority bets. This role is for you if you’re excited by:
   

  

* Leading through craft, setting vision and unlocking customer impact: you will define where a product should go, then jump into the details with the team to unblock, teach, and ship. You raise the bar through product judgment, design craft, and your ability to make everyone around you better.
* Actually shipping and demonstrating real impact: You'll start by owning a product area and team to build trust and get your bearings at Ramp, with room to take on broader leadership over time. You'll stay close to customers and ship meaningful work alongside your designers, product managers and engineers.
* Building the environment where great work comes from: clear roles, high standards, low ego, and just enough structure to keep the bar high without slowing people down. That means building a caring yet demanding structure, investing deeply in people — coaching, feedback, growth — so designers can do the best work of their careers and develop in this new age of Design.


 It’s never been a more interesting time to build.
   

  

***Please note that this role will require you to be comfortable with working in\-person at our NYC HQ (located near Madison Square Park) at least 3 days/week.***
 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Lead and grow a high\-performing team of product designers
* Own product vision and design direction across critical product areas
* Partner with product and engineering to shape strategy and deliver customer impact
* Stay close to customers and use their feedback to guide product decisions
* Jump into the work when needed to unblock teams and accelerate progress

* Raise the bar for product thinking, interaction design, systems thinking, and craft
* Coach designers through clear feedback, high standards, and strong mentorship
* Help define how design works in an AI\-native world
* Build strong partnerships across product, engineering, data, and design


 What You Need
   

  

* Experience leading and developing high\-performing product design teams
* Strong product judgment, design craft, and systems thinking
* Track record of shipping products with meaningful customer and business impact
* Deep customer empathy and comfort operating in ambiguity
* Ability to influence across functions and develop exceptional talent
* Curiosity that borders obsession over how AI changes the nature software and how we work


 Nice to Haves

title: Director of Brand Media
description:
**About FINN Partners**  

  

FINN Partners is a fast\-growing, global independent marketing agency recognized for its bold ideas and collaborative spirit. Our expertise spans integrated marketing, media, and creative services, offering clients a unified team focused on business and brand growth. The Performance Media team leads performance strategy across paid search, social, programmatic, and audience insights, while the Brand Media team leads brand strategy across narrative and channel selection. The two teams build every media plan together, aligned to a single business outcome. Media joins client engagements at the earliest stages, working alongside strategy and creative to develop one integrated campaign.  

  

**Position Summary**  

As Director of Brand Media, you will own brand media strategy across the agency's client roster, leading upper\-funnel channel selection, narrative development, and innovation partnerships. You will build every media plan in lockstep with the Performance Media team, ensuring brand and performance are planned as one connected, interdependent system.  

You will manage and develop the Brand Media team, own new business planning for brand media, and represent FINN's media perspective and point of view externally. You will surface media landscape insights and media channel context in the strategy brief, shaping how campaigns come to life from the outset.  

  

**What You'll Do*** Lead brand media strategy and channel selection across multiple client accounts, ensuring narrative and channel choices connect directly to business objectives
* Partner with the Performance Media team to build every plan as one integrated system, aligned to a single business outcome

**What You'll Bring*** Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

* Proven experience leading brand media strategy and channel planning across multiple accounts

* Experience managing significant client budgets and investment decisions

* Strong new business pitch experience, from strategic ideation through proposal development and delivery

* Strong proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office, particularly Sheets/Excel and Slides/PowerPoint

title: Digital Director, Central Communications
description:
**About:** New America’s mission is to generate big ideas and bold solutions for a new America. We envision an America that represents and serves the public, where institutions work for all Americans, where workers, families, and communities can thrive, and where people are secure from existential threats.

**Primary Function:** New America is seeking a visionary, creative, and highly organized digital leader to serve as Digital Director within its Central Communications team. The Digital Director will shape and lead New America’s digital communications strategy, including its website and digital publishing platforms, visual brand, data visualization, analytics, and responsible adoption of emerging technologies.


The Digital Director will oversee four direct reports on the Central Communications digital team: The Front\-End Developer, Digital Marketing Manager, Senior Data Visualization Developer, and Senior Visual Designer and Brand Lead. The Digital Director will establish priorities, support professional development, and foster an effective, collaborative team responsible for digital product development, marketing, visual storytelling, brand implementation, and performance measurement.


Building on the successful launch of New America’s redesigned website and refreshed brand in 2026, the Digital Director will lead the critical next phase of the organization’s digital evolution: turning these foundational investments into sustained audience growth, deeper engagement, and greater influence for New America’s ideas. The opportunity is to move from launch to measurable impact—continually improving how audiences discover, understand, and act on New America’s work; developing more ambitious digital products and storytelling formats; strengthening the organization’s brand and reputation across channels; and building the systems, insights, and practices needed to reach new and evolving audiences. The Digital Director will define what comes next and establish a clear roadmap for delivering it.


Reporting to the Vice President of Content and Communications, and working closely with other Central Communications colleagues, New America’s experts, emerging leaders, program teams, and operations colleagues, the Digital Director will translate organizational goals into a cohesive digital strategy and product roadmap. The ideal candidate combines strategic vision with technical fluency, sound management, creative problem\-solving, and the ability to lead complex work involving multiple stakeholders and competing needs.

**Responsibilities:**

### **Digital strategy and product leadership**

* Set the vision and strategy for New America’s website, digital publishing tools, audience\-development channels, and data visualizations/interactive storytelling capabilities.
* Develop and oversee a digital product roadmap that aligns organizational goals, audience needs, and available resources, while ensuring digital products adhere to best practices for accessibility, user experience, privacy, performance, and search visibility.
* Lead product\-development processes involving internal stakeholders and external vendors.
* Identify opportunities to expand New America’s interactive storytelling and data\-visualization capabilities in ways that increase the reach and impact of its research and policy ideas.
* Evaluate New America’s digital systems on an ongoing basis and make informed budget, staffing, technology, and vendor recommendations to the VP of Content and Communications.

### **Website management and digital publishing**

* Lead the next phase of New America’s website strategy, ensuring that the site continues to evolve as an effective digital publishing, storytelling, and audience\-engagement platform.
* Develop and manage a website roadmap centered on audience growth, content discovery, usability, accessibility, and performance.
* Partner with editorial, research, policy, development, events, and communications colleagues to understand their evolving needs and translate them into scalable digital solutions.
* Manage relationships with web\-development agencies and technical vendors, including project scope, budgets, timelines, deliverables, and performance.
* Champion user\-centered product development, incorporating audience research, usability testing, analytics, and staff feedback loops to inform continuous improvement.
* Establish clear governance for website content workflows, feature requests, quality assurance, maintenance, and publishing responsibilities.

### **Audience development and analytics**

* Guide New America’s digital analytics and measurement strategy, ensuring performance data connects clearly to communications and impact goals.
* Translate analytics into actionable recommendations for content strategy, audience development, and resource allocation across teams.
* Establish ethical, privacy\-conscious standards for how the organization collects, targets, and experiments with audience data.
* Champion organization\-wide fluency with digital insights, presenting findings in ways that resonate with both technical and non\-technical colleagues.

### **Brand stewardship**

* Serve as New America’s primary organizational brand steward.
* Lead the continued evolution of New America’s visual identity to ensure that it remains distinctive, credible, accessible, and aligned with the organization’s mission and reputation.
* Partner closely with the Senior Visual Designer and Brand Lead and other Central Communications colleagues to maintain a consistent and high\-quality look, feel, and voice across New America’s website, publications, events, campaigns, social channels, and other public\-facing products.
* Establish and maintain brand standards, templates, tools, training, and review processes that enable colleagues across the organization to apply the brand effectively.
* Advise senior leaders and program teams on high\-visibility brand decisions and identify opportunities to strengthen New America’s reputation over time.
* Monitor how New America’s brand is expressed and perceived across channels, using audience feedback, research, and performance data to recommend thoughtful improvements.

### **Team leadership and organizational collaboration**

* Lead, manage, and mentor a multidisciplinary team spanning web development, digital marketing, data visualization, visual design, and brand.
* Establish clear responsibilities, goals, workflows, and performance expectations while supporting staff growth and professional development.
* Foster an inclusive, creative, accountable, and collaborative team culture.
* Develop internal processes, guidelines, and service models that support effective collaboration on digital communications.
* Present digital strategies, product concepts, recommendations, and tradeoffs clearly and persuasively to senior stakeholders with varying levels of technical and design knowledge.
* Build productive relationships with external agencies, consultants, technology providers, and other partners.

### **Emerging technologies and responsible AI**

* Develop a forward\-looking vision for how emerging technologies—including AI—can responsibly strengthen New America’s research communications, digital publishing, audience engagement, internal capabilities, and reputation as a public policy think tank.
* Evaluate and pilot tools that could improve content discovery, accessibility, workflow efficiency, audience understanding, data visualization, or digital storytelling.
* Serve as a vital member of the AI governance committee to develop responsible practices for selecting and using AI\-enabled tools and ensure experimentation reflects New America’s standards for accuracy, transparency, editorial and research integrity, accessibility, and human oversight.
* Monitor digital trends and best practices and recommend investments that advance New America’s mission without compromising trust or quality.

### **Digital governance, security, and operational resilience**

* Partner with New America’s IT and operations teams to assess cybersecurity, privacy, data\-governance, and technology needs related to the organization’s public\-facing digital platforms.
* Maintain appropriate governance and documentation for critical digital systems, domains, integrations, administrative access, vendors, and account ownership.
* Support incident\-response planning for website outages, account compromises, publishing errors, misinformation, and other digital or reputational risks.

**Qualifications:**

**Candidates should have**:

* At least eight years of relevant professional experience, including at least three years managing staff.
* Demonstrated experience developing and implementing an organization\-wide digital strategy.
* Significant experience leading digital product development, website management, web design, or a related function.
* Experience managing and mentoring multidisciplinary staff and building effective, collaborative teams.
* Demonstrated ability to develop product roadmaps, prioritize competing needs, and lead complex projects from planning through implementation and evaluation.
* Working knowledge of HTML and CSS.
* Familiarity with modern web\-development technologies and frameworks, including JavaScript and React, and content management systems such as WordPress or Drupal.
* Experience with Google Analytics or comparable analytics platforms and the ability to translate performance data into strategic recommendations.
* Experience with project\-management tools such as Asana, Trello, Jira, Monday.com, or similar platforms.
* Knowledge of current user experience, user interface, web accessibility, privacy, and digital publishing practices.
* Experience incorporating user or audience research throughout the product design and development lifecycle.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, interpersonal, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrated success collaborating with senior leaders and colleagues across diverse disciplines, roles, and levels of technical expertise.
* Experience managing external agencies, consultants, or technology partners.
* Sound judgment and the ability to navigate sensitive, high\-visibility, or reputationally significant decisions.
* A flexible, collaborative, and solutions\-oriented approach to challenges.
* Familiarity with the opportunities and risks associated with generative AI and other emerging technologies, including responsible\-use considerations.
* Experience stewarding or implementing an organizational brand across multiple digital and visual channels.
* A commitment to inclusive, accessible, and audience\-centered communications.
* Experience in public policy, research, journalism, higher education, advocacy, or another mission\-driven environment is a plus.

**Compensation and Benefits:** This position is a full\-time role with benefits. The annual salary will be between **$135,000\.00 – $150,000\.00**, depending on experience.


New America offers a highly competitive benefits package that includes health care, dental, and vision coverage; a generous retirement plan; paid time off; observes all federal holidays; and an office\-wide closure between Christmas and New Year’s Day.

**Location:** Washington, DC\-based candidates are preferred, but fully remote arrangements may be considered for the right candidate.

**Application Process:**


Please submit a cover letter, résumé, and links to relevant work samples or a portfolio. Applications that do not include the requested materials will not be considered. **The application deadline is September 30**. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and early submissions are encouraged.

***No phone calls or emails will be answered***

**Physical Requirement:**

* This position is hybrid, working from home and in an office environment and sits at a desk for extended periods of time and requires dexterity to operate general office equipment;
* The person in this position will frequently communicate with peers, management, company partners/vendors, and the general public and must be able to exchange accurate and timely information verbally and in writing and
* This position may require walking, bending, kneeling, and standing and will require sitting for extended periods of time.

**Work Environment:**

* The work environment is in an indoor office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and filing cabinets

**Originality and Transparency:** At New America, we value authentic voices and intellectual property rights. All application materials, including, cover letters, writing samples, and any other submissions, must be solely your own original work. The use of AI text generation tools like ChatGPT, language models, or other artificial intelligence writing assistants is strictly prohibited for any part of your job application. Applicants have a responsibility to be fully transparent about authorship and any tools or resources utilized. We celebrate human ingenuity and want to hear your genuine thoughts and experiences

description:
**At Caris, we understand that cancer is an ugly word—a word no one wants to hear, but one that connects us all. That’s why we’re not just transforming cancer care—we’re changing lives.**

  

We introduced precision medicine to the world and built an industry around the idea that every patient deserves answers as unique as their DNA. Backed by cutting\-edge molecular science and AI, we ask ourselves every day: *“What would I do if this patient were my mom?”* That question drives everything we do.

  

But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare—driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose.

 **Join us in our mission to improve the human condition across multiple diseases. If you're passionate about meaningful work and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, Caris is where your impact begins.**

**Position Summary**


The Senior Director \- Digital Marketing is responsible for defining and executing Caris Life Sciences’ digital marketing strategy across the organization’s full portfolio of molecular science and precision oncology products and services. This role owns the digital ecosystem—including corporate and product websites, physician\- and patient\-facing portals, the marketing technology (MarTech) stack, the customer relationship management (CRM) platform, digital campaigns, social and digital media, and marketing analytics—ensuring every digital touchpoint reflects Caris’ position as a leader in precision medicine.


This leader manages a cross\-functional team spanning web and digital production, marketing operations, CRM and database marketing, and digital creative. The Senior Director partners closely with Product Management, Medical Affairs, Sales, Information Technology, Corporate Communications, and other Marketing leaders to translate complex molecular science into clear, compelling, and compliant digital experiences for oncologists, biopharma partners, payors, and patients.


The ideal candidate combines deep digital marketing expertise with fluency in the precision medicine and oncology landscape and can move seamlessly among strategy, hands\-on execution, and cross\-functional leadership.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Own the strategy, roadmap, and performance of all Caris digital properties, including the corporate website, product and solution pages, and physician\- and patient\-facing portals.
* Ensure digital content and site architecture accurately reflect the current product portfolio, scientific positioning, and regulatory and compliance requirements specific to diagnostics and precision oncology.
* Partner with user experience, design, information technology, and web development resources to continuously improve site performance, accessibility, search engine optimization, and conversion across physician, biopharma, and patient audiences.
* Serve as the primary digital marketing partner for new product launches, product enhancements, and platform updates, ensuring digital assets, landing pages, and campaigns are ready in advance of go\-to\-market timelines.
* Translate technical and scientific product information into digital content that resonates with distinct audiences, including ordering physicians, pathologists, biopharma partners, and patients.
* Collaborate with Product Management and Medical and Scientific Affairs to ensure digital messaging remains aligned with the latest clinical evidence and test menu changes.
* Lead the marketing CRM platform strategy, including segmentation, lead scoring, marketing automation, and integration with sales and customer engagement systems.
* Manage marketing operations functions, including campaign workflows, digital asset management, data hygiene, and reporting infrastructure that support the broader marketing organization.
* Evaluate and recommend MarTech investments that improve personalization, targeting, efficiency, and performance across digital channels.
* Establish and monitor digital marketing key performance indicators, including website traffic, engagement, lead conversion, and campaign return on investment, and develop reporting that connects digital performance to business outcomes.
* Identify trends in digital health, oncology and precision medicine, competitive digital presence, and healthcare consumer behavior, applying insights to strengthen the digital strategy.
* Use A/B testing, customer journey analytics, and audience data to continuously optimize digital campaigns and website experiences.
* Guide the organization’s social media and digital thought leadership presence, ensuring content reflects Caris’ science, culture, and leadership in precision oncology.
* Oversee the development of digital\-first marketing and communications materials, including website content, email, digital advertising, interactive presentations, and event microsites, that clearly communicate the value of Caris’ molecular solutions to patients, physicians, and partners.
* Lead the creation of personalized, digitally native marketing experiences that drive engagement throughout the customer lifecycle.

title: Brand ambassador (video content) & community — Fitune LATAM
description:
* **Format:** 
 Part\-time or full\-time
* **Location:** 
 Mexico City. Remote day\-to\-day, with in\-person studio visits in CDMX 2\-3 times a month
* **Language:**



 \- Native or fluent Spanish required.
 



 \- Professional English for internal communication
 



 \- Portuguese is a plus
 



  





  





**\-\-What's Fitune** 




 Fitune is the intelligent operating system for fitness and wellness studios.
 



 Studios across Latin America run their business on complicated software or manual processes. We built Fitune so that running and growing a studio is easier and more profitable: a conversion\-optimised website and app, booking, in\-person classes, events, courses and 1\-on\-1s, automated payments and subscriptions, client and business management, and more.
 



 Fitune launched in 2021 and now serves hundreds of studios processing more than a quarter of a million bookings a month, with a 30\-person team across Mexico, Colombia, Chile and Brazil. We aim to grow past 3,000 studios in 2027\.
 



  





 Our product in action
 


* Example studio website: https://www.myfitune.io/playhardgym
* On\-demand demo: https://www.fitune.io/watch\-demo
* Our website: www.fitune.io



  





**\-\-The role** 




 We are looking for the on\-camera face of Fitune in Latin America: a senior creator who is active in the fitness world, genuinely energetic, and happiest when they are in a studio talking to the people who run it.
 



 This person owns the relationship between Fitune and the community around it — studio owners, coaches, and the people who train in those studios. They visit to studios, interview owners, film sessions and events, create challenges and activations, and turn all of it into content that studio owners want to watch and share.
 



 It is a hands\-on role. You concept it, you present it, you film it, you edit it, you publish it, and you answer the comments.
 



 In short: you help turn Fitune into the most valuable brand for fitness studio owners in LATAM.
 



  





**\-\-What you'll do: On\-ground execution and community building** 




 Visit to top studios to interview owners, cover live training sessions and events, and capture testimonials. Create challenges and activations that bring studios and their communities into the Fitune orbit. Build real relationships with partner studios, coaches, and end users — the kind where people text you before they text support.
 



  





**\-\-Premium video production** 




 Own video end to end, from concept to published cut. Short\-form and long\-form, both edited to a standard that matches a premium brand. You are comfortable being the only person on set.
 



  





**\-\-Product representation** 




 Star in and produce product videos that translate technical features into content people actually finish watching. You make software feel useful and human.
 



  





**\-\-Be the face of Fitune Academy** 




 You are the image of Fitune Academy, our educational platform for fitness and wellness studios. You present the courses, tutorials and masterclasses that teach owners and coaches how to run and grow their business, and over time your face becomes the one people associate with learning at Fitune. That means holding a consistent on\-camera identity across every lesson, keeping the material clear and practical rather than promotional, and working with product and marketing to decide what the community needs to learn next.
 



  





**\-\-Channel and community management** 




 Manage day\-to\-day publishing across Facebook (including Facebook groups like Pilates coaches groups, etc) , Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn. Own the content calendar, adapt formats per platform, optimise captions and descriptions, monitor performance, and reply to comments and DMs so the community stays responsive.
 



  





**\-\-Content strategy and growth** 




 Work with marketing, product and sales to turn launches into content, share studio success stories, educate owners on growing their business, test new formats, and improve performance based on what the numbers say.
 



  





**\-\-AI\-accelerated workflow** 




 Use generative AI tools (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, plus video and audio automation) to move faster on scripting, brainstorming, social listening and post\-production.
 



  





**\-\-Authenticity safeguard** 




 Know exactly where AI efficiency ends and human connection begins. Every final script, cut and comment reply should feel organic and specific to the culture of the fitness community it is speaking to.
 



  





**\-\-Types of content you'll create** 




**Short\-form social content** 



* https://www.instagram.com/p/DVObFk\-Ebut/
* https://www.instagram.com/p/DU500q7DlVb/
* https://www.instagram.com/p/DS3CieVDkSa/



**Long\-form interviews with studio owners** 



* https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=XP8gSAU8Ndk
* https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=hJEQtnxjU9k



**Educational, tutorial and webinar content** 



* https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=XnsxSHQefvk



 Plus Fitune Academy videos, product feature highlights, event coverage, community challenges and activations.
 



 \-\-
 



  





**Who you are** 



* You are active in the fitness or wellness world. You train, you know the vocabulary, you understand what a studio owner's Monday looks like.
* Your energy is the point. You are warm, enthusiastic, and inviting on camera and off it, and people relax around you.
* You love making things. High standards on craft, and you would rather reshoot than publish something you are not proud of.
* You genuinely enjoy people. Meeting them, interviewing them, remembering their names, building something they want to be part of.
* You are hands\-on and autonomous. You pitch your own hooks, run your own days, and do not need a producer to get something shipped.
* You are comfortable in a room with a high\-profile studio owner and equally comfortable with the coaches and members on the floor.
* You are curious and constantly generating ideas.



 \-\-Skills and experience
 



  





**Must have** 



* Proven experience creating video content for social media
* Comfortable presenting on camera as the face of a brand
* Experience with short\-form content (Reels, TikTok, Shorts)
* Ability to film and edit your own content end to end, short and long form
* Strong storytelling for digital platforms
* Strong understanding of social media trends and formats
* Exceptional interpersonal skills, with the confidence to network with business owners



  





**Technical skills** 



* Video editing tools
* Basic design tools (Canva, Figma)
* Camera and lighting basics
* Social media publishing and scheduling tools
* Generative AI tools for scripting, ideation and post\-production



  





**Language** 



* Native or fluent Spanish. Content will be in Spanish
* Professional English for internal communication



  





**Bonus points** 



* Background working in fitness, wellness or sports
* Experience producing interview\-style content
* Experience creating educational or tutorial content
* Experience growing a social media audience from a standing start
* Existing network among studio owners or coaches in Mexico



 \-\-What success looks like
 



**First 30 days.** 
 You have visited your first studios, published your first short\-form pieces, and know the product well enough to demo it on camera.
 



**First 90 days.** 
 A consistent publishing rhythm across channels, a recognisable on\-camera presence, the first long\-form interviews live, and a growing set of studio relationships.
 



**First 6 months.** 
 Measurable growth in audience and engagement, a repeatable content engine, and a community where studio owners and coaches participate rather than just watch.
 



  





**\-\-Location and logistics** 



* Based in Mexico City
* Day\-to\-day work is remote
* In\-person studio visits and interviews in CDMX 2\-3 times a month, support in events and other activations, plus occasional travel to other markets



 \-\-Hours and format
 



 This role can be part\-time or full\-time depending on the person and their other commitments. Tell us in your application which you are looking for and what your availability looks like.
 



  





**\-\-How to apply** 




 Think you'd be a great fit for this position at Fitune?
 



 Fill out our job application form here
 



  




* **Include a link to content you have made and appear in. A reel, a channel, a client project — whatever shows us how you are on camera.**

title: Director - Workflow Design and Governance
description:
Join a dynamic team at the pulse of global markets, where we deliver innovative software and service solutions for essential financial reporting and capital markets transactions. At DFIN, we are a values\-driven organization that empowers you to build a fulfilling career while bringing your authentic self to work every day. Our *“Win as One”* mentality ensures that our team’s success is directly linked to Client, Shareholder and Employee Satisfaction.



In 2026, DFIN was named \#1 on the 2026 Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces® by Best Practice Institute. We have also been recognized as one of America’s Most Loved Workplaces® for five consecutive years and a Built In Best Place to Work for six years, reflecting our continued commitment to supporting employees’ total well\-being. Enjoy competitive compensation, a flexible workplace, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for professional growth. Bring your passion and talents to DFIN – because being YOU thrives here.
**Summary:**
------------



The Director of Workflow Design and Governance is responsible for providing leadership and accountability for workflow strategy, process design, and governance across Client Service \& Delivery. This role defines, standardizes, documents, and continuously improves end\-to\-end workflows to support consistent, scalable, and measurable execution aligned to business objectives, client expectations, quality, delivery, and cost. The role partners closely with Client Service \& Delivery leaders, production teams, offshore partners, cross\-functional stakeholders, and business leaders to strengthen workflow discipline, clarify ownership, and improve operational outcomes.



Client Service \& Delivery is evolving toward a connected, workflow\-led operating model that improves consistency, predictability, scalability, and accountability.



This role is central to that shift by establishing governance routines, standardizing ways of working, translating operational needs into clear workflow requirements, and ensuring processes are designed, adopted, measured, and improved over time. The successful candidate will have:


* experience designing, governing, and improving end\-to\-end workflows across complex operational environments; experience establishing process standards, governance routines, documentation practices, and adoption approaches that deliver measurable business value; experience translating workflow needs into clear requirements, process maps, SOPs, training materials, metrics, and decision\-ready materials for operational teams, management, and senior leadership
* experience collecting, organizing, and analyzing workflow, quality, productivity, cycle time, capacity, and service performance data to identify root causes, define improvement opportunities, and support measurable action plans
**Responsibilities:**
---------------------



Client Service \& Delivery


* Define, design, govern, and continuously improve end\-to\-end workflows across Client Service \& Delivery with a focus on standardization, quality, delivery predictability, capacity utilization, client experience, and cost effectiveness.
* Establish workflow design principles, process standards, documentation expectations, and governance routines that support consistent execution across teams, functions, and offshore partners.
* Lead multiple workflow design, governance, and improvement initiatives simultaneously across Client Service \& Delivery workstreams.
* Define workflow requirements through interviews, workshops, document reviews, current\-state assessments, workflow analysis, data analysis, and site visits, including offshore locations as needed.
* Quantify operational, client, financial, and non\-financial impacts to inform workflow prioritization and governance decisions.
* Ensure workflow objectives, decision rights, process ownership, adoption needs, and success measures are clearly identified, documented, governed, and managed to completion. Proactively identify risks, roadblocks, and governance decisions requiring escalation.
* Establish and maintain named workflow owners, decision rights, escalation paths, and accountability for process performance.
* Design and maintain workflow documentation, including process maps, SOPs, governance materials, training content, operating routines, workflow standards, reporting requirements, and system enhancement recommendations.
**Responsibilities (cont.)**
----------------------------


* Lead training design, implementation support, and adoption planning for new or revised workflows, including process certification or readiness activities where appropriate.
* Prepare and deliver workflow governance updates, recommendations, and decision\-ready materials with limited guidance from leadership.
* Create clear storylines that simplify complex workflow, governance, and performance information into practical recommendations and next steps
* Deliver presentations tailored to operational teams, cross\-functional partners, vendors, and senior leadership.
* Identify, lead, and facilitate workflow governance and process design workshops focused on current\-state review, future\-state design, standardization, root\-cause analysis, continuous improvement, and team readiness.
* Schedule and conduct regular governance reviews with Client Service \& Delivery teams, offshore partners, and management to evaluate workflow performance, review metrics, identify trends, resolve issues, and align on action plans.
* Partner with Business Performance \& Analytics and operational leaders to define workflow KPIs, reporting needs, dashboards, scorecards, and governance materials using PowerBI, Excel, and other data presentation tools.
* Partner with Business Performance \& Analytics to measure adoption, operational outcomes, and value realization following workflow implementation.
* 15% Travel, in addition to annual International/offshore travel is required
**Responsibilities (cont.)**
----------------------------



Employee/Team Development


* Foster a culture of workflow discipline, continuous improvement, operational excellence, and governance accountability for stakeholders and operational team members. This includes providing expertise and modeling the use of process design methods, governance routines, workflow mapping, data analytics, process optimization, and change adoption practices.
* Develop workflow design and governance capability across direct reports, subject matter experts, and operational partners.
* Drive operational rigor by implementing consistent workflow design, process documentation, governance review, issue resolution, and continuous improvement approaches across Client Service \& Delivery.
* Coordinate workflow governance routines and business reviews using a consistent presentation model. Execute workflow improvements using the operational pillars of simplification, standardization, leveraging software and technology, actionable metrics, and value creation while keeping data and people safe.
* Ensure workflow standards, application\-support practices, and process controls align with applicable regulatory information\-security, data\-protection, and risk\-management requirements.
* Develop trusted relationships with key stakeholders and partners so workflow issues, governance decisions, and improvement opportunities are addressed with clarity, accountability, and a spirit of partnership.
**Qualifications:**
-------------------


* Bachelor’s Degree
* 6\+ years in a similar role demonstrating proven proficiency in workflow design, process governance, continuous improvement, operational excellence, project management, or business analysis.
* Proven experience leading workflow, process design, governance, or improvement efforts across cross\-functional teams, offshore teams, or vendors.
* Proven leadership, employee development, facilitation, teamwork, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Proficient in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook), PowerBI, and process mapping or workflow documentation tools such as Visio. Lean, Six Sigma, PMP, process design, or comparable certification is a plus.
* Ability to provide thought leadership in workflow design, governance, process standardization, and operational excellence.
* Ability to influence through persuasion, negotiation, facilitation, and consensus building.
* Highly proficient in workflow mapping, process documentation, process optimization, governance routines, and adoption planning with the ability to coach team members and stakeholders on consistent ways of working.
* Strong project management and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate across Operations, Technology, Product, Analytics, vendors, and leadership teams to deliver workflow change and strengthen governance discipline.
* Ability to synthesize and simplify complex workflow, process, technology, data, and operational requirements for teams and stakeholders and connect recommendations to business objectives.
* Comfort working with ambiguity, evolving operating models, and new workflow challenges. Ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

At Crocs, Inc. you’re not expected to fit a mold. You’re encouraged to break it and create something better.
  
  

Overview
  
  

Crocs is seeking a Sr. Director, Head of Content Production, to lead the people, partners, systems, and production craft that bring our brand stories to life around the world.
  
  

The Global Studio is more than a production engine. It is where creative ambition becomes real, where an idea becomes an image, a film, a product story, or a digital experience that millions of consumers encounter. Reporting to the Vice President, Global Creative, this leader will shape how Crocs creates content with greater impact, consistency, speed, and imagination.
  
  

This individual will lead the full global studio ecosystem across campaign, e\-commerce, video, post\-production, and digital asset management. They will build the right mix of internal capabilities and external creative partners, elevate production craft, and design modern ways of working that help teams move at the pace of culture without compromising the idea or the brand.
  
  

The ideal candidate is both a creative production leader and an enterprise builder. Someone with exceptional taste, deep production fluency, and the operational vision to create a future\-ready studio. This individual is encouraged to understand how to protect the creative idea and unlock talent. They should make complexity feel clear and turn investment into content that strengthens the brand and drives the business.
  
  

THE KIND OF LEADER WHO THRIVES HERE
  
  

You see production as a creative discipline, not simply a service or a handoff.
  
  

You understand how images, films, product stories, and experiences build a brand over time.
  
  

You have exceptional judgment and taste, and you know how to translate a creative vision into work that feels distinctive, relevant, and unmistakably Crocs.
  
  

You are equally energized by the big idea and the details that determine whether it lands.
  
  

You build trust across creative, marketing, product, digital, merchandising, finance, legal, and regional teams.
  
  

You lead change with clarity and empathy, helping teams adopt new tools and ways of working while raising the creative bar.
  
  

You stay curious about culture, creators, emerging technology, and new models of content creation.
  
  

At Crocs, we call that Wonderfully Unordinary.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
Lead with a studio vision by defining and delivering a global studio strategy that turns brand ambition into a modern, connected content ecosystem.
  
Elevate the brand through craft by setting a high bar for photography, film, motion, e\-commerce, social, and post\-production so every asset strengthens the Crocs brand.
  
Lead production from creative briefing and feasibility through casting, capture, post\-production, localization, delivery, and archiving.
  
Reimagine how content is made by integrating AI\-enabled workflows, CGI, automation, real\-time capture, and emerging tools with clear creative, legal, and brand standards.
  
Develop scalable models that protect a strong global idea while enabling relevant, effective execution across regions, channels, and consumer moments.
  
Inspire and develop producers, studio operators, post\-production, and DAM and metadata teams while building clear roles, capabilities, and career paths.
  
Build a high\-performing network of photographers, directors, production companies, studios, post partners, talent, and specialist creators.
  
Establish clear workflows, decision rights, production calendars, quality standards, and performance measures that improve speed, visibility, and accountability.
  
Own and optimize a multi\-million\-dollar production budget, balancing efficiency with the level of craft and ambition required to grow the brand.
  
Connect studio performance to creative quality, asset effectiveness, speed to market, reuse, localization, and business priorities.
  
Collaborate closely with Creative, Brand Marketing, Product, Digital, E\-commerce, Merchandising, Media, Finance, Legal, and regional teams to align ambition, resources, and delivery.
  
Lead multiple high\-visibility productions and team members while protecting the idea, making timely decisions, and keeping teams moving.
  
Communicate studio vision, investment choices, production recommendations, and transformation plans clearly to executive leadership and external partners.

title: Director of Renewals
description:
**Help us build the next generation of renewals at Sembi.**


Sembi is the parent company behind leading software quality and DevOps brands including **TestRail, Xray, Testmo, Ranorex, PreEmptive, and Kiuwan**. Our products help development, QA, and security teams build, test, secure, and ship better software with confidence.


We’re bringing these businesses together to create a stronger, more connected customer experience while preserving the unique strengths of each brand. As we continue to grow, we’re investing in the capabilities that will help us build lasting customer relationships, and renewals is at the heart of that mission.

### **The Role**


We’re looking for a **Director of Renewals** to lead our global renewals organization across the Sembi portfolio.


This is an opportunity to build and lead a world\-class renewals function spanning six established software brands and thousands of customers around the world. You’ll own the strategy, operating model, forecasting, performance, and team responsible for protecting Sembi’s recurring revenue and strengthening customer retention.


This isn’t a role focused simply on processing renewals. We’re looking for someone who can transform renewals into a **predictable, data driven, customer centric revenue engine**.


You’ll report to the VP of Customer Experience and work closely with Customer Success, Support, Sales, Finance, Operations, Product, and Marketing leaders across Sembi.

### **What You'll Own**

* **Lead Sembi’s global renewals strategy** across TestRail, Xray, Testmo, Ranorex, PreEmptive, and Kiuwan, owning retention performance, renewal bookings, churn, contraction, and overall renewal outcomes.
* **Build a predictable renewals engine** with consistent methodologies, processes, playbooks, and operating rhythms across brands and customer segments.
* **Own the renewals pipeline and CRM discipline**, establishing clear standards for opportunity management, renewal stages, close dates, risk identification, and data quality.
* **Drive forecasting and executive visibility**, building reliable renewal forecasts, dashboards, and reporting that clearly communicate pipeline health, risks, trends, and expected outcomes.
* **Identify and mitigate renewal risk early**, partnering with Customer Success and other teams to develop proactive strategies for at\-risk customers and prevent avoidable churn.
* **Use data and customer insights to improve retention**, analyzing churn, contraction, renewal performance, and customer trends across products, segments, and geographies to identify opportunities for improvement.
* **Lead, coach, and develop a high performing global renewals team**, establishing clear goals, accountability, performance expectations, and career development.
* **Partner across the business** with Customer Success, Support, Sales, Finance, Operations, Product, and Marketing to create a connected customer lifecycle and seamless renewal experience.
* **Improve systems, automation, and operational efficiency**, partnering with Operations and Finance to strengthen CRM data, system integrations, workflows, and reporting.
* **Evolve the renewals function into a strategic revenue discipline**, continuously raising the bar on predictability, productivity, customer retention, and scalable growth.

### **What You Bring**

* Significant experience leading SaaS renewals, customer success, account management, or another recurring revenue function.
* Proven success improving retention and reducing churn at scale.
* Experience managing a substantial recurring revenue portfolio and renewal forecast.
* Strong understanding of SaaS metrics including GRR, NRR, churn, contraction, ARR, and forecast accuracy.
* Experience building or transforming renewal processes and operating models.
* Strong analytical, strategic, and operational skills.
* Exceptional cross functional leadership and communication abilities.
* A track record of building and developing high performing teams.
* Comfort working across multiple products, customer segments, and geographies.
* A builder's mindset: you see ambiguity as an opportunity to create something better.

### **Why This Role?**


This is a chance to have **portfolio level impact**.


You won’t be responsible for renewals for just one product. You’ll help define how six established Sembi brands retain and grow their customer relationships. You’ll have the visibility and influence to shape strategy, improve how we operate, develop a global team, and directly impact one of the most important drivers of our business.


If you’re an experienced renewals leader who loves building teams, creating predictability, solving complex problems, and turning customer retention into a competitive advantage, **we’d love to meet you.**

title: Senior Manager, Invoice-to-Cash Operations
description:
**Build the future, spark innovation and align your career with purpose.**


McKinstry is innovating the waste and climate harm out of the built environment and creating lasting impact. Together, we’re building a thriving planet.


Buildings are a leading contributor to the climate crisis, generating nearly 40% of total global energy\-related carbon emissions. We’re making a lasting impact on our industry and within our communities by addressing the climate, affordability and equity crises through:

* renewables and energy services
* engineering and design
* construction and facility services


To get where we’re going, we need big thinkers, problem solvers and collaborative mindsets. Does that sound like you?

**The Opportunity with McKinstry**


McKinstry is looking for a **Senior Manager, Invoice\-to\-Cash Operations** to join our growing Finance and Accounting division. This position is responsible for leading the Invoice\-to\-Cash function, including billing, collections, cash application, customer payments, reporting, and supporting technology platforms. Serves as the primary leader responsible for day\-to\-day Invoice\-to\-Cash operations, operational performance, and working capital results. Partners with the Director, Accounting Operations on organization design, process improvements, and system initiatives while maintaining ownership of execution, issue resolution, and team performance. Additional responsibilities may include:

*Operational Leadership \& Performance*

* Own Invoice\-to\-Cash operations, including billing, collections, cash application, customer payments, AR aging, and related customer data processes.
* Establish priorities, KPIs, service levels, and operating rhythms to drive execution, accountability, and working capital performance.
* Lead resolution of issues impacting cash flow, customer experience, and operational performance.
* Ensure the function can support business growth and operational complexity through timely execution, clear ownership, accountability, and escalation of issues.

*Leadership \& Functional Development*

* Lead and develop managers/supervisors, team leads, and senior individual contributors responsible for Invoice\-to\-Cash operations across billing, collections, cash application, and customer master data.
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, performance expectations, and escalation paths to drive execution and team performance.
* Support organizational growth through leadership development, succession planning, and operating model improvements.

*Working Capital \& Customer Operations*

* Drive billing, collections, cash application, customer onboarding, and AR aging performance through strong partnership with Line of Business Operations team members and Finance \& Accounting teams.
* Own the accuracy, timeliness, and quality review of Invoice\-to\-Cash cash forecast inputs, ensuring forecasts are reviewed and validated before distribution.
* Improve visibility into customer payment issues, collection risks, and operational barriers impacting cash flow.
* Lead initiatives that improve cash conversion, customer experience, operational efficiency, and overall Invoice\-to\-Cash performance.

*Technology, Third\-Party Partners \& Operational Readiness*

* Lead the operational execution of ERP implementations, system enhancements, and process changes across Invoice\-to\-Cash, partnering with the Director, Accounting Operations on priorities, design decisions, and business outcomes.
* Manage third\-party partners supporting payment processing, collections, lockbox operations, and billing technology services.
* Provide business leadership for ERP implementations, system enhancements, and technology initiatives, ensuring solutions improve operational performance, controls, automation, and scalability.

*Controls, Compliance \& Continuous Improvement*

* Ensure Invoice\-to\-Cash processes comply with company policies, internal controls, tax requirements, and audit standards.
* Identify risks and process gaps and implement practical solutions that improve compliance, efficiency, and consistency.
* Standardize processes and strengthen accountability across the function.
* Partner with Finance \& Accounting teams and Audit to support audit readiness, issue resolution, and continuous improvement**.**

**What You Need To Succeed at McKinstry:**

*Education \& Leadership Experience*

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field required.
* 8\+ years of progressive experience in Accounts Receivable, Billing, Collections, Invoice\-to\-Cash, Accounting Operations, Revenue Accounting or relevant Finance Operations
* 3\+ years leading large transactional teams through supervisors, managers, and team leads.
* Experience managing large\-scale Invoice\-to\-Cash operations in complex, multi\-entity organizations with AR portfolios exceeding $200M across diverse customers, contract structures, and business models.
* Experience using operational reporting and data to drive performance, identify risks, and support decision\-making.

*Functional \& Industry Expertise*

* Strong understanding of working capital management, internal controls, management reporting, and accounting fundamentals.
* Strong knowledge of GAAP and project\-based accounting, including progress/unit billing, collections, percentage\-of\-completion, change orders, intercompany transactions, DSO, gross margin performance, AR management, and account reconciliations.
* Experience in construction, manufacturing, engineering, or other complex project\-based businesses, including multi\-entity operations and customer\-specific billing requirements.
* Proven ability to establish KPIs, reporting, operating rhythms, and accountability processes that improve execution, controls, and service delivery.
* Experience leading operational improvements and resolving complex business issues through strong cross\-functional partnership.

*Systems, Technology \& Leadership Capabilities*

* Experience leading teams through ERP implementations, business transformation, and organizational change.
* Experience with billing systems, customer payment portals, cash application tools, and third\-party service providers.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Proven ability to lead through growth, system change, and operational complexity while maintaining focus on customer service, cash flow, controls, and business results.

**PeopleFirst Benefits**

**When it comes to the basics, we have you covered:**

* Competitive pay
* 401(k) with employer match and profit\-sharing plan
* Paid time off and holidays
* Comprehensive medical, prescription, dental, and vision with low or zero deductible options and low out of pocket maximums

**People come first at McKinstry, and we go beyond the basic benefits with:**

* Family formation benefits, including adoption and IVF assistance
* Up to 16 weeks paid parental leave
* Transgender inclusive benefits
* Commuter benefits
* Pet insurance
* “Building Good” paid community service time
* Learning and advancement opportunities via McKinstry University

See benefit plan documents for complete details.

**If you’re driven by our vision to build a thriving planet together, McKinstry is the place to build your career.**

title: Director Product Design
description:
**About The Team**
 Design at Miro sits at the heart of how millions of people experience collaboration. Our product design team works across the full breadth of the platform, from the foundational canvas experience to the emerging AI\-powered capabilities that are redefining how teams think, create, and build together. We're a team that cares deeply about craft, moves with intention, and believes that great design is inseparable from great outcomes.
   

  

 As Miro continues to grow and evolve, the design team is scaling to meet that ambition. We're investing in leadership that can raise the bar on both the quality of our work and the health of our teams, people who understand that building a great design org and shipping great product experiences are the same job.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Director of Product Design, you will lead a small team and be an active designer yourself. This is not a role where leadership means distance from the work. You'll be the creative director for your area of the product, shape how design thinks about problems and solutions, and then roll up your sleeves to ensure the execution matches the vision.
   

  

 This role is critical because Miro is at an inflection point. AI is changing what collaboration software can and should be, and the design decisions made now will shape how teams around the world work for years to come. You'll have the scope, the resources, and the mandate to do some of the most consequential design work of your career.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Set the creative vision for your product area and hold the bar for it — not just in words, but in the work itself. You'll define what good looks like, then stay close enough to the craft to know when you're getting there and when you're not.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of product designers across multiple levels, building a culture where rigorous critique and psychological safety exist in the same room.
* Get your hands dirty at the moments that matter, shaping early frameworks when the problem is still fuzzy, writing the interaction logic that unlocks a stuck design, pushing the details on a surface that's going to be seen by millions.
* Drive design strategy across the full Discover, Define, and Deliver lifecycle, making sure the team is asking the right questions before they're crafting the right answers.
* Align stakeholders across Product, Engineering, and Analytics around a shared design direction, and hold that direction with conviction through the ambiguity and tradeoffs of real product development.
* Run design critiques that are genuinely useful: direct, and focused on making the work better rather than making everyone comfortable.
* Spot gaps in team capability and make the case for what we need to build — through hiring, development, or how we structure the work.


**What You’ll Need**
* 10\+ years of product design experience, with at least 4 years leading and managing teams in a technology company.
* A portfolio that demonstrates both strong strategic thinking and high\-quality craft — work that you shaped at the system level alongside work where your hands were directly on the pixels.
* Proven experience designing AI\-powered or AI\-adjacent product experiences, with a clear point of view on what good looks like when the system is dynamic, generative, or probabilistic.
* Deep fluency with modern design tools, particularly Figma, and comfort working within or evolving a mature design system.


**What's In It For You**
 We want you to feel supported, connected, and ready to grow. Our global benefits package generally includes equity, a wellbeing benefit, a WFH equipment allowance, and an annual Learning \& Development stipend. Join a diverse team where you can do your best work. Full benefits may differ per location. If you would like to learn more about location\-specific benefits, please refer to our Global Miro benefits board.
   

  

*The reasonably estimated salary range is specific to New York and may not be applicable to other locations. Final compensation and total package components will be based on individual factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. The range for this role is:*
 New York salary range
   

  

 $237,000—$356,000 USD
   

  

**About Miro**
 Miro is a visual workspace for innovation that enables distributed teams of any size to build the next big thing. The platform's infinite canvas enables teams to lead engaging workshops and meetings, design products, brainstorm ideas, and more. Miro, co\-headquartered in San Francisco and Amsterdam, serves more than 100M users and 250,000 companies collaborate in the Innovation Workspace. Miro was founded in 2011 and currently has more than 1,600 employees in 13 hubs around the world.
   

  

 We are a team of dreamers. We look for individuals who dream big, work hard, and above all stay humble. Collaboration is at the heart of what we do and through our work together we hope to create a supportive, welcoming, and innovative environment. We strive to play as a team to win the world and create a better version of ourselves every day. If this sounds like something that excites you, we want to hear from you!
   

  

**Check Out More About Life At Miro**

* Blog: https://miro.com/careers/life\-at\-miro/all/
* Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mirohq/


 At Miro, we strive to create and foster an environment of belonging and collaboration across cultural differences. Miro’s mission —
 *Empower teams to create the next big thing* 
 — is how we think about our product, people, and culture. We believe that creating big things requires diverse and inclusive teams.
 *Diversity* 
 invites all talent with different demography, identities and styles
 *to step in* 
 , and
 *inclusion* 
 invites them to step
 *closer together.* 
 Every day, we are working to build a more diverse Miro, cultivate a sense of belonging for future and current Mironeers around the world, and foster an environment where everyone can collaborate and embrace differences.
